description: HMME multigenerational pot experiment (Methods 2.1, p3-p4), tomato cv. Cal Ace in pots with 200 g soil. Soils: receptor Andisol R (Barros Arana series) alone, or 80% R + 20% of one of five Antarctic donor soils (Y Yelcho, C Coppermine, A Arctowski, F Fildes Bay, D Deception). G0: one 4-week cycle before any water-regime split. From G1, the pots of each soil combination and of R were divided into water deficit vs well-watered (90% WHC). Water deficit started after 20 d at 90% WHC: 50% WHC G1-G3, 40% G4-G5, 20% G6, 10% G7, 5% G8-G10, with each cycle ended at MSB stage 4. Seedlings were pruned and re-sown in the same soil for 10 generations over 96 weeks. Sampled at G0, G2, G5 and G10. Explicit crossing: 6 soils x 2 water regimes. Pot n not reported. The same pots/soil carry over across generations (lmer with random sample id; p5), so allocation is REPEATED across generations.
system: controlled-environment pots (16/8 h, 21/15 C, 70% RH, 1,100-500 umol m-2 s-1; Taylor and Foy nutrient solution every 15 d)

description: Validation of the transferred microbiome (Methods 2.3, p5): 30 g of resilient-generation (G10) soil fumigated with 200 mL CHCl3 for 24 h (F+) vs a parallel non-fumigated desiccator incubation (F-). Tomato seeds (same cultivar) grown in a greenhouse at 16/8 h, 21/15 C, 70% RH and 90% WHC, then at 50% WHC after acclimatation. Measured: CFU, stress index and proline (Supplementary Figure 8). Source soil mixture(s), n and pot independence not specified. No biomass or yield outcome; CONTEXT only.
system: greenhouse pots

description: Growth-room pot experiment, tomato cv. Micro Tom (1 L pots, compost:vermiculite:perlite 5:1:1 + 2 g CaCO3 lime + 1 g slow-release 7/7/7 fertilizer; 27/22 +/- 2 C, 16/8 h, 80 +/- 5% RH, 120 umol m-2 s-1; complete randomized block design): 2 conditions (unstressed 27/22 C vs moderate heat stress 31/24 C day/night, 16/8 h, 80% RH, 14 d in a growth chamber from plant age 108 to 122 d, then 1-week recovery at 27/22 C) x 3 foliar treatments (distilled water control, C129 ANE, PSI-494 ANE at 0.106% w/v, sprayed at 105 d and again after the stress period; unstressed plants sprayed on the same schedule). 3 independent plant trials x 6 plants per group and condition (n=18 biological replicates); two-way ANOVA condition x ANE treatment (Table 3). Sampling at 122 d (height, flower number, pollen viability, PQ-SPAD/PhiII/PhiNPQ; leaf/flower sugars and HSP qPCR on samples pooled per trial) and 129 d (fruit number per plant, fruit set stage). No fruit-yield mass or dry biomass reported.
system: growth_room (heat stress phase in growth chamber); 1 L pots

description: Commercial greenhouse trial, E.D.A.R. Balsicas (Murcia, Spain), April-September 2018 (20-week exposure); tomato Solanum lycopersicum var HULK F1; randomized 2x2x2 factorial: soil type (traditional agricultural soil T vs mixed substrate M = soil + washed coconut fibre 20 L per linear metre, PELEMIX) x AMF (Glomus iranicum var. tenuipharum, SYMBORG, 500 g m-3 added manually to soil/substrate before transplant, + vs -) x irrigation water (control water EC 0.994 vs saline reclaimed water EC 3.107, Table 1); 3 replications x 11 plants per treatment (33 plants/treatment, 264 plants); irrigation water applied by rows (3 rows control, 3 rows saline RW). Fruit yield (kg fruit plant-1), fruit number and mean fruit weight reported only as factor-level marginal means (Table 5).
system: commercial greenhouse, soil/mixed substrate in rows, localized drip irrigation (one 3 L h-1 emitter per plant, twice daily) to 100% water-holding capacity

description: Greenhouse pot experiment, tomato cv. Moneymaker in 4 L pots (3.5 L sand/vermiculite 1:1), randomized block design (4 blocks), 100 plants; NM (autoclaved inoculum + filtrate mock) vs AM (Funneliformis mosseae BEG12, 10% substrate volume at transplant); ample water to day 36 (WW harvest), then water withheld with destructive harvests at day 42 (WD1) and day 47 (WD2); plant data from core-containing pots n = 4-6 per treatment and harvest.
system: greenhouse pot, sand/vermiculite substrate

description: Open-field processing tomato (H-1015 and UG 812J F1 hybrids, pooled) at Szent Istvan University Experimental Farm, Godollo, Hungary, 2018 and 2019 seasons; water supply (I0 rainfed / DI 50% of RI dose / RI 100% ET drip) main plots x PGPR seedling root-dip consortia (B0/B1/B2/B3) subplots; split-plot RCBD with 4 repetitions; total, marketable, green and diseased fruit yield t/ha per season (Table 3).
system: field

description: Field experiment April-June 2011, Yancheng Teachers University plot, Yancheng, Jiangsu, China; tomato cv. 'jingdan No. 1' (1-month-old purchased seedlings), sandy loam, no fertilizer. Randomized block design, 3 replicate plots (1 x 2 m) per treatment, 3 seedlings per plot. 12 treatments = 3 irrigation salinity levels (tap water OS, 1.0% NaCl MS, 2.0% NaCl HS; 400 mL per plant every 3 days) x 4 inoculation levels (uninoculated water-dip control, E. persicinus RA2, B. pumilus WP8, P. putida RBP1 at 10^8 cfu/mL root dip 20 min pre-transplant). Sampling 2 months after transplanting.
system: field_trial

description: Field experiment August-October 2011, Yancheng Teachers University (plot location different from E1); tomato cv. 'jingdan No. 1', sandy loam, no fertilizer. Same randomized block 3 x 4 design as E1 (OS/MS/HS NaCl irrigation x none/RA2/WP8/RBP1 root-dip inoculation), 3 replicate plots per treatment, 3 seedlings per plot. Sampling 2 months after transplanting.
system: field_trial

description: Greenhouse pot experiment, tomato cv. Alisa, 25 cm polyethylene bags with 7 kg non-sterile sandy soil, Menoufia University, Egypt; all pots irrigated with 200 mM NaCl in Hoagland's solution; six inoculation treatments (uninoculated control, W, W+S, S, A, A+S) by triple seedling root dip before transplanting; randomized block design, three replications per treatment; 90 d growth; Table 2 reports dry weight and fruit yield (g/plant) as mean +/- SD of three replicates.
system: greenhouse pots

description: Greenhouse pot experiment, Univ. Naples Federico II, Micro-Tom tomato sown May 2014; split plot factorially combining 2 nutrient solution strengths (100%, 70% BNS) x 3 NaCl levels (0, 42.5, 85 mM) x 3 algal treatments (water control, Rygex 1:400, Super Fifty 1:500; 200 mL/pot substrate application at transplanting 35 DAS, repeated every 2 weeks); 5 plants per experimental unit, 3 replicates (270 plants); destructive harvest 90 DAS.
system: greenhouse; 10-cm plastic pots, pure peat moss, drip fertigation

description: Greenhouse pot experiment, tomato cv. H-86 (Kashi Vishesh), ICAR-IIVR Varanasi, India; 2x2 factorial: irrigation 80% F.C. (full, control) vs 40% F.C. (half, deficit) x without vs with hexa-PGPM consortium (20 ml, 20-25 min root dip of 25-day-old seedlings at transplanting); 7-kg earthen pots, sterilized soil:FYM 4:1; 16 h light, 25/15+/-2 C, RH 50-70%; 4 treatments x 3 replications x 5 pots; replication means analysed (n=3). Season/year not reported.
system: insect-proof greenhouse, pots

description: Petri-dish germination test of tomato cv. Bella on 1% water agar with NaCl 0 (water), 75, 100, 125 mM; 20 seeds/dish, RCBD with three replications, 28 C growth chamber, germination after 3 d; Results 3.1 also reports seedling root/shoot length and dry-weight reductions (percent only) after 10 d in pots. No inoculation.
system: Petri dish / growth chamber

description: Pot plant-growth promotion (Methods 2.4, Table 2): seeds dip-coated in Pseudomonas suspensions (10^7-10^8 cells/ml) vs un-inoculated, sown in 7 cm x 10 cm pots of non-saline Tashkent soil (EC 2.3 dS/m) or saline Syr-Darya soil (EC 7.1 dS/m); randomized design, ten replications; six weeks under open natural conditions; shoot/root length and whole-plant dry weight (g/plant, 100 C). Table 2 has three unlabelled rows per strain.
system: pot, open natural conditions

description: Biocontrol of Fusarium solani foot/root rot (Methods 2.5, Table 3): 500 ml pots of non-saline (EC 2.3) or saline (EC 7.1) soil; treatments (i) no pathogen no bacteria, (ii) pathogen control, (iii) pathogen + bacteria (pre-germinated seeds coated with strain); F. solani spores 2x10^7/ml; RCBD four replications, 24 pots per treatment; five weeks; diseased plants (%) +-SD.
system: pot, open natural conditions

description: Rhizosphere survival of rifampicin-resistant mutants of five Pseudomonas strains on tomato roots (Methods 2.6, Table 4): potting soil, four weeks greenhouse, non-saline vs saline (75 mM NaCl per Methods; Table 4 footnote EC 0.5 vs 7.5 dS/m); log10 CFU/g root +-SD. No un-inoculated arm.
system: pot, greenhouse

description: Greenhouse yield trial (Methods 2.7, Table 5), Tashkent province: un-inoculated vs seed-coated P. chlororaphis TSAU13 vs P. extremorientalis TSAU20; seedlings raised in soil:biohumus 2:1 pots, transplanted at 2-4 leaf stage into 3 m x 2.5 m plots (six rows, 50 x 60 cm) of calcareous sierozem soil EC 5.6 dS/m in an un-heated greenhouse; four replicate plots per treatment, RCBD; four months; plant height, total fruit yield (kg/m2), N/P/K.
system: greenhouse plots

description: Six-week potting-soil greenhouse experiment, control vs P. extremorientalis TSAU20 under non-saline vs saline condition (75 mM NaCl per Results 3.6): plant fresh weight g/plant, leaf H2O2 and proline (Table 6) and GR/APX/SOD/CAT activities (Fig. 1, N=4 plants, SD). No dedicated Methods description of the growth design.
system: pot, greenhouse

description: Greenhouse soilless tomato 'Huno F1': absolute control, 1 g Cs-PVA hydrogel/plant, 10 mg Cu NPs absorbed on 1 g Cs-PVA hydrogel/plant (substrate, pre-transplant), each with 0 or 100 mM NaCl in nutrient solution from week 3 after transplanting; CRD, 16 plants/treatment (5 for biochemistry).
system: multi-tunnel polyethylene greenhouse; soilless peat moss:perlite (1:1) in 12 L black polyethylene bags; Steiner nutrient solution; single-stem plants, 3 plants m-2

description: Tomato cv. Micro Tom growth-room pot trial (1-L pots, compost:vermiculite:perlite 6:1:1, 27/22 C, 16 h light), 2x2 factorial Salinity (tap water EC 0.7 dS/m vs saline irrigation 50 mM NaCl 7 d then 100 mM NaCl 21 d starting 3 d after first spray, then tap water) x PSI-475 foliar spray (water vs 2.5 mL/L at 56 d and 87 d plant age); complete randomised block design, 22 plants/tray, tray-level irrigation; 3 independent trials pooled, n>=22 plants per treatment and condition; fruits harvested at 126 and 154 d, phenotype at 154 d.
system: growth room, potted plants (1-L pots)

description: Greenhouse pot experiment, JUST campus Jordan, March-June 1999: RCB 2x2x2 factorial salt (ECe 1.4 vs 4.9 dS m-1, NaCl:CaCl2 1M:1M via irrigation) x AMF (none vs Glomus mosseae 50 g moist inoculum/pot pre-planting) x cultivar (Pello, Marriha); 4 replications, 16 L pots of nonsterilized silty clay:sand 2:1 with 2 plants/pot; grown to fruit maturity.
system: greenhouse pot

description: Tomato cv. Moneymaker 100-day field trial, Universidad de Talca, Chile, spring 2018. Genuine 2x2 factorial: irrigation NaCl 50 mM (the source control, a baseline salinity) vs 150 mM, 40 mL/day per plant, crossed with an Antarctic root fungal endophyte mix (P. brevicompactum AFE001 + P. chrysogenum AFE002), E- vs E+. 100 seedlings were randomly assigned to 4 treatments, about 25 per treatment. Each treatment was assigned to 4 independent rows (0.2 m between plants, 0.5 m between rows), so plants are nested in treatment rows. A two-way ANOVA (salt x endophyte) was run on final yield. Final fruit dry yield per plant was taken at a single terminal harvest at the end of the experiment (Fig. 1, n=25 plants per group).
system: open field, clay-rich soil (about 49 mM NaCl background), Talca, Chile

description: Pot experiment, open-field conditions, Amity Institute of Organic Agriculture, Noida, India. Tomato in 12-inch pots with 7 kg sterilized field soil:coco-peat 1:1, 4 seeds sown then thinned to 1 plant/pot, no chemical fertilizer. 2 salinity levels (distilled water vs 100 mM NaCl, EC 10 dS/m, irrigated twice daily) x 5 Pseudomonas sp. S3 inoculation conditions (0.03 M MgSO4 uninoculated control, seed treatment, root dipping, soil drenching, seed treatment + soil drenching). Single destructive harvest 30 d after inoculation/salt exposure: root/shoot length, fresh weight and dry weight (60 C, 3 d) in Table 1; leaf biochemistry in Fig 6. Methods: 5 replicates, CRBD; Table 1 caption: n=3, mean +/- SD.
system: pot, open-field conditions

description: Context-only seed germination assay. 10 surface-sterilized seeds per 10 cm Petri dish on Whatman filter paper, 3 dishes per treatment, 10 d in growth chamber. 2x2: paper moistened with tap water vs 100 mM NaCl x uninoculated vs Pseudomonas sp. S3 seed bacterization (1e8 cfu/mL in 0.03 M MgSO4). Outcomes are germination % and seedling vigor index (Fig 4b printed table, mean +/- SD, n=3), with no fruit yield or dry biomass.
system: Petri dish germination, growth chamber

description: Growth-chamber hydroponic 2x2 factorial, tomato cv. Ailsa Craig seedlings: NaCl 0 vs 125 mM x food-waste vermicompost leachate 0 vs 18 mL/L in half-strength aerated Hoagland solution for 7 days after 1-week acclimation; 20 tanks (5 per treatment x 4 seedlings), complete randomized block design; growth on 6 plants per treatment, mean +/- SE.
system: growth chamber hydroponic (half-strength aerated Hoagland, 1.5 L tanks, 16 h photoperiod, 150 umol m-2 s-1, 25/20 C)

description: Growth-chamber pot experiment, tomato cv. Vir Yegwang seedlings in 3x-autoclaved field soil (plastic pots 440x270x195 mm). Biostimulant: Bacillus cereus SA1 (1 L of 10^9 CFU/mL per pot, 1 week after transplanting, repeated twice at 5-d intervals), humic acid 500 mg/L applied similarly, or SA1+HA; controls received autoclaved double-distilled water. Stress: from V3 stage, heat 37C 14 h / 30C 10 h vs normal 28C 14 h / 25C 10 h, RH 60-70%, 15 days; sampled at 15 d. Complete 2x2x2 crossing (8 groups a-h), three replicates per group, DMRT.
system: controlled growth chamber, pots

description: Growth-chamber pot experiment (Univ. Modena and Reggio Emilia, Italy; 0.4 L pots, neutralized peat, one seedling per pot): full factorial 3 processing-tomato genotypes (Everton, H3402, Pearson) x 3 AM treatments (M- control, MF+ F. mosseae, MR+ R. intraradices) x 2 irrigation regimes (100% vs 55% RSWC for 15 d from 21 d after sowing) = 18 cells, fully randomized, 5 biological replicates per cell, n = 90; per-cell mean +/- SD (n = 5) in Supplementary Tables S1-S4.
system: growth chamber, 0.4 L pots, neutralized peat

description: Glasshouse pot experiment, Northwest A&F University, Yangling, China (sown 3 Dec 2020); tomato cv. Jinpeng 10; completely randomized 2 x 4 factorial: Bacillus pumilus ACCC 19290 inoculation (none/mock vs 10^8 CFU/mL root soak 4-5 h + 1 mL planting-hole at transplanting, 30 DAS) x four irrigation regimes (I1 35%, I2 30%, I3 25%, I4 20% v/v SWC) for ca. 3 weeks; n=4 pots (one plant each) per cell; plus pre-stress first-harvest cohort (4 non-B.p., 4 B.p.) at 2 weeks after transplanting; final harvest 5 weeks after transplanting.
system: glasshouse; 6 L pots (15 cm diameter x 30 cm depth), 6 kg air-dried silty clay loam, one plant per pot

description: Greenhouse pot experiment 1, NPK-fertilized (1 l of 2 g/l Multi-Feed NPK per tray of 10 pots at 24 d, ~0.2 g/plant): 2x2 factorial T. harzianum T34 seed coating (-/+) x salt (2 l/tray of 300 mM NaCl at 32 and 36 d, or none); tomato cv. Marmande, 0.7 l pots, Projar substrate, 10 plants/condition, harvest at 39 d (Table 1 gas exchange, Table 2 growth, Fig 1 qPCR).
system: greenhouse pots

description: Greenhouse pot experiment 2, identical to E1 but without supplementary Multi-Feed NPK: 2x2 factorial T. harzianum T34 seed coating (-/+) x salt (2 l/tray of 300 mM NaCl at 32 and 36 d, or none); tomato cv. Marmande, 40 plants (10/condition), harvest at 39 d (Table 3 gas exchange, Table 4 growth, Fig 3 qPCR).
system: greenhouse pots

description: Tomato (Solanum lycopersicum cv. Reimlams Rhums) greenhouse pot experiment, explicit factorial: AM inoculation (NM control with autoclaved inoculum + microbial filtrate vs Rhizophagus irregularis EEZ 58, 10 g inoculum ~60 infective propagules/g at sowing) x 3 water regimes (WW ~100% FC/22% vol.; moderate drought ~75% FC/14% vol.; severe drought ~55% FC/8% vol.; imposed from transplanting). 15 pots per treatment, one plant per pot; independent sets of 5 plants per treatment destructively harvested at 4, 6 and 8 weeks after sowing. Parallel lettuce part of the same paper is out of crop scope.
system: greenhouse pot (1000 g sterilized soil:quartz sand:vermiculite 2:2:1 v/v/v)

description: Tomato cv MicroTom climatic-chamber pot experiment; 2 x 5 completely randomized factorial: NaCl 0 vs 120 mM (in modified Hoagland NS, twice weekly from 10 DAG, 5 applications) x foliar biostimulant (Control distilled water; C Malvaceae PH; D Trainer legume PH; H Vegamin legume PH; P Poaceae PH; 3 mL/L weekly from 12 DAG, 3 applications); 3 biological replicates x 2 plants per treatment; destructive harvest 28 DAG; RDW/SDW from one plant per biological replicate (n=3).
system: controlled climatic chamber; 200 mL pots, 150 g sand:sieved peat 1:1 w/w; 14/10 h, 24/19 C, 250 umol m-2 s-1, 70% RH

description: Tomato cv. Kecskemeti F1 growth-chamber pot experiment (one plant per pot, 570 g sterile peat:sand 1:4, capillary irrigation on floral foam). 2 x 4 factorial: Funneliformis mosseae BEG12 inoculum (20 g soil with spores/mycelia per pot at transplanting) vs same amount of autoclaved inoculum x stress (control; heat 1 week daily ramp peaking 42 C 10:00-14:00; water deficit 2 weeks, water level 1 cm, VWC ~8.25%; combined heat + water deficit). 8 treatments x 6 replicate plants; single destructive sampling directly after stress, 9 weeks after transplanting. Two-way ANOVA (inoculation x stress) + Tukey; mean +/- SD.
system: growth chamber pot, capillary irrigation (modified Snow and Tingey)

description: Viol/tray-grown SC2121 tomato seedlings (32-cell viols, 38 cc; garden soil:barnyard manure 2:1). 12 groups = 4 NaCl levels (0/50/100/200 mM, 10 ml soil drench) x 3 foliar L-glutamic acid levels (0/250/500 mg/L), twice weekly for 8 weeks; seedlings harvested after applications ended for Table 3 (shoot/root FW and DW), Table 5 and Figs 1-2. Elmadagi, Ankara; 17 Apr-28 Jul 2022. Group 11 mapped from Methods as 200 mM + 250 mg/L.
system: outdoor garden, seedling viols (32-cell trays), soil:manure 2:1

description: Bag-grown SC2121 tomato plants (polyethylene seedling bags 25x50 cm; transplanted at 2-3 leaf stage, 2 weeks adaptation before applications). Same 12 NaCl x L-GLU groups; NaCl 350 ml soil drench per application; foliar L-GLU twice weekly for 8 weeks; 9 pots with 3 replications per group. Table 4: root collar, leaf/branch/flower number, fruit width/length and Fruit FW (no unit printed; 10 randomly selected fruits = individual fruit mass, not fruit yield). Group 11 mapped from Methods as 200 mM + 250 mg/L.
system: outdoor garden, polyethylene seedling bags/pots 25x50 cm, soil:manure 2:1

description: Growth-room pot experiment, tomato (cultivar not reported) in sterilized pot soil. Six pre-treatments (CONTROL with deionized water; Bc biocompost; Bf biofertilizer; Bc70/Bf30; Bf70/Bc30; RNA corrector; each 50 mL of 2% solution, root watering, day 24 and day 31 after sowing) crossed with NaCl (0 vs 150 mM, 40 mL, day 35 and day 38). Terminal sampling at day 40. Table 1 'Plant DW (g)' is the dry-biomass target (means +/- SE, three replications of pooled material).
system: growth_room_pot

description: Greenhouse pot experiment, tomato cv. Saladette, 3 NaCl irrigation levels (0 = deionized water, 100, 200 mM NaCl) x 4 inoculation treatments (uninoculated, P. fluorescens UM270 WT, UM270 deltaclsA, UM270 deltaclsB; OD600=1, weekly after transplanting), 12 single-plant pots per treatment, single evaluation after five weeks of plant growth (Methods 2.8 p8; Table 6 p30).
system: greenhouse pots, sterile peat moss, one plant per pot

description: Experiment 1 (Methods 2.2.1): completely randomized two-factor pot experiment, A. nodosum extract formulation soil drench (SA 0, 2.5, 5, 10, 20 mL L-1; 100 mL per pot weekly x6 from 35 DAS) x soil moisture (M50, M75, M100 % FC); 15 treatment combinations x 4 replications (one plant per pot). Analysed by two-way ANOVA (Table 1 SA, M, SA x M). All 15 cells reported in Tables 2-5.
system: Naturally-lit polyhouse, black plastic pots with 15 kg Bangkok clay soil, AIT Pathum Thani Thailand, Jan-May 2021

description: Experiment 2 (Methods 2.2.2): completely randomized two-factor pot experiment, same A. nodosum extract formulation as foliar spray (FA 0, 2.5, 5, 10, 20 mL L-1; 100 mL per pot weekly x6 from 35 DAS, soil surface covered; control sprayed with 100 mL tap water) x soil moisture (M50, M75, M100 % FC); 15 treatment combinations x 4 replications (one plant per pot). Two-way ANOVA (Table 1 FA, M, FA x M). All 15 cells reported in Tables 6-9.
system: Naturally-lit polyhouse, black plastic pots with 15 kg Bangkok clay soil, AIT Pathum Thani Thailand, Jan-May 2021

description: Greenhouse pot experiment, tomato (Solanum lycopersicum, unnamed local variety), 30 cm pots with agricultural soil; seeds surface-sterilized, treated 1 h in 100 ml culture broth with/without E. hormaechei MF957335, germinated 15 d, transplanted; E. hormaechei applied alone or with NaCl 150/200/250 mM or with K-feldspar 1.0/2.0/3.0 g/pot; drenched at one-month interval; 4 months Dec-Apr, RH 55%, 30+/-5 C; harvested after 4 months; triplicates; one-way ANOVA + LSD across 8 groups; bars mean +/- SE (Figs 2-4). No NaCl-only or K-feldspar-only arm. Locators: PDF p2 Methods, p3 Statistical analysis, p4-5 Figs 2-4.
system: greenhouse pot (30 cm pots, agricultural soil)

description: Greenhouse (multi-tunnel, polyethylene) soilless tomato 'El Cid F1' crop, 102 days; 6 treatments: T0 control (no NaCl, no Se NPs), NaCl-only (50 mM NaCl in Steiner solution throughout crop), and 1, 5, 10, 20 mg/L chitosan-PVA Se NPs applied to substrate (5 applications every 2 weeks from 11 DAT, total 55.2 mL/plant) plus 50 mM NaCl. Completely randomized design, 6 replicate plants per treatment. No Se-only arm; NaCl-only arm is a shared control for the 4 Se+NaCl arms.
system: greenhouse soilless; 10 L polyethylene bags; peat moss:perlite 1:1 (v/v); Steiner nutrient solution; directed irrigation

description: Open-field tomato (Solanum lycopersicum cv. Nador F1) trial, Morocco, 10 Mar-1 Jun 2019, raised beds on clayey saline soil (EC 1.07 mS/cm), drip irrigation (EC 0.2 mS/cm), no fertilizer. 2x2 foliar biostimulant design: Control (water only), Tecamin Flower (TF) 3 mL/L, Tecamin Brix (TB) 3 mL/L, TF+TB (3 mL/L each); 10 plants per treatment x 3 replicates (120 plants). Fruit yield (kg fresh fruit/10 plants) by size class cumulated over 5 weekly harvests (Table 1, p5).
system: open field, raised beds, drip irrigation

description: Greenhouse pot experiment (24 cm pots, sandy-loam soil + 10% perlite, 4 plants per m2, three-span polytunnel), tomato 'plum' cv. Pixel F1, Experimental Centre Dept. Agricultural Sciences, Univ. Federico II, Portici (Naples), Italy; 3 AMF-based formulate levels (Non-inoculated control, Rizotech Plus, Myco Apply DR) x 4 soil EC levels (1.5, 3.0, 4.5, 6.0 mS cm-1 via fertigation with balanced nutrient solutions) in explicit factorial combination; split-plot design, 3 replicates, 4.5 m2 per treatment; run in 2016-17 and 2017-18, results reported only as two-year pooled means.
system: greenhouse pot, soil + perlite, drip fertigation

description: Open-field tomato (genotype E42 landrace), Bellizzi (Salerno), Italy, 2019 season (transplant 19 June 2019), clay-loam soil; randomized block design, 3 replicates; 2 x 2 factorial: irrigation 100% vs 50% of Class A pan evaporation (deficit from 22 DAT to end) x CycoFlow (fertigation 3 g/L at transplanting and every 15 days, 4 applications) vs non-treated. Table 1 (p3) reports all four cells with ANOVA W, B, W x B.
system: open field, drip irrigation, clay-loam soil

description: Greenhouse drip-irrigated tomato (cv. Tone Guitar hybrid), Almohous Farms, Thadiq, Saudi Arabia, Sep 2021-Jun 2022: full factorial 2 irrigation water quality (fresh 0.93 vs NaCl-saline 2.3 dS m-1) x 4 irrigation levels (100, 80, 60, 40% ETc) x 2 biochar (BC0% vs date-palm biochar 5% w/w, 2.16 kg m-2) = 16 treatments; RCBD split-split-plot, water quality main plot, irrigation subplot, biochar sub-subplot; 3 replicates; 48 units (6 m x 1 m drip line, 15 plants). Control = fresh water 100% ETc BC0%.
system: GREENHOUSE_SOIL_DRIP

description: Greenhouse pot experiment, IFTM Uberaba Campus, MG, Brazil, 11 Oct 2019 - 10 Jan 2020 (tropical summer, uncontrolled greenhouse temperature). Single-factor completely randomized design: 4 treatments (untreated control, Alquifishmel, Booster, Stimulate) x 6 repetitions; plot = 5 plants, one per 13-L pot, 0.5 x 1.0 m spacing (estimated 20,000 plants ha-1). Tomato cv. Conquistador hybrid. ANOVA + Tukey; control shared by three biostimulant contrasts. Not factorial: no stress factor imposed (ambient heat common to all arms).
system: Greenhouse, 13-L pots with Bioplant Prata substrate, drip fertigation, single-stem vertical training

description: In vitro germination of saladette-type tomato seeds on agar-water in Petri dishes at 0, 20, 60, 100 mM NaCl x five seed treatments (uninoculated Control; Bacillus sp. SVHM1.1; Halomonas sp. SVCN6; Halomonas sp. SVHM8; 1:1:1 consortium), seeds soaked 60 min in 10 mL inoculum (~1 Abs625, ~1.5x10^9 ufc/mL); 25 seeds per treatment, triplicate, 25 C, 16 h light/8 h dark, read at 12 d; Table 1 mean +/- SE, two-way ANOVA (Table 2). No fruit-yield or terminal dry-biomass endpoint (CONTEXT only).
system: in vitro germination chamber, agar-water Petri dishes

description: Greenhouse bioassay: 40-d tomato seedlings transplanted to 5 L peat bags; factorial (Methods 2.4) of NaCl in irrigation water (0, 20, 60, 100 mM, every 3 d; Steiner solution 2 dS/m pH 6 on intermediate days) x inoculation (uninoculated Control; Bacillus sp. SVHM1.1; Halomonas sp. SVCN6; Halomonas sp. SVHM8; 1:1:1 consortium) at ~1 Abs625 at start and weekly to the end; 180 d from transplant; five plants per treatment; Table 3 cumulative fruit yield (g/plant, harvest 90-180 d) and terminal plant dry weight (g), mean +/- SE, all 20 cells; two-way ANOVA with interaction (Table 4).
system: greenhouse, 5 L peat-filled polyethylene grow bags

description: Greenhouse run-to-waste hydroponic (perlite bags) tomato cv. Belladonna experiment, Mediterranean Agronomic Institute of Chania, Greece, autumn-spring (mid-October to end of April). Complete 2x2 factorial: NaCl salinity (0 vs 50 mmol/L in nutrient solution, EC ramped over 2 weeks to 7.50 mS/cm) x silicon (0 vs 2 mmol/L K2SiO3 in nutrient solution via drip fertigation). CRD, 4 replication plots x 6 plants per treatment; 16 plants (4/plot) experimental units; Table 1 means +/- SE (n = 8). Yield = fruit from first four clusters, kg per plant.
system: greenhouse hydroponic soilless (perlite, run-to-waste, drip fertigation)

description: Single protected-environment (plastic greenhouse) tomato experiment, Technical Irrigation Center, State University of Maringa, PR, Brazil, 27 Nov 2020 - 1 Apr 2021, Tucaneiro hybrid. Completely randomized design, factorial scheme 2 x 5: two water replacement levels (70% and 100% of lysimeter-measured ETc; reduction to 70% from 7 DAT; seasonal water 329.06 vs 470.08 mm; daily drip irrigation) x five Ascophyllum nodosum extract (Acadian) doses (0, 0.1, 0.2, 0.3, 0.4% v/v = 0-4 mL per L water) applied by soil drench, 2 L per bed per application, at 15, 30, 45, 60 and 75 DAT. Four 3 x 0.5 m beds per treatment (40 beds, 6 plants each), three central plants per bed evaluated (12 plant replicates per treatment). system: environmentally controlled glasshouse hydroponics (half-strength Hoagland, 12 L plastic boxes)

description: Tomato cv. Heinz 3402 pot experiment (single pots, Radicom peat substrate) under natural open-field conditions, Piacenza, Italy, 21 June-8 July 2021, 18 DAT; 5 groups (C, S 150 mM NaCl daily irrigation, S+PH Clever HX 10% v/v, S+SW Ascovip 10% v/v, S+PH+SW 5%+5% v/v), foliar 2 mL/plant at 3, 7, 14 DAT; 8 randomly distributed biological replicates (pots) per group, 3 for biomass and 5 for leaf analyses; one-way ANOVA + Tukey HSD.
system: open-field pot experiment

description: Tomato cv. F144 growth-chamber pot experiment: single plants in 0.4 L pots inoculated once with one bacterial strain (40 mL, 10^8-10^9 CFU/mL in sterile M9 buffer) or non-inoculated with sterile M9 buffer, then all subjected to withheld watering; whole plants measured at 7, 14, 21 and 33 days. Means of 3 replicates +/- SD per Fig S1 caption; tomato values only in Supplementary Figure S1, which is not registered.
system: growth chamber

description: Greenhouse pot experiment, tomato cv. Superdotaerang in 9 cm pots with Bunong commercial mix; bacterial drench (OD600 0.25 in 10 mM MgSO4, 1 ml/g) at 3 weeks old; 1 week later balanced salinity solution (EC 36.5 mS/cm, 1 ml/g, x3 at 2-day intervals) or distilled water; final harvest 3 weeks after challenge (7 weeks old). Complete 4 x 2 inoculum x stress factorial; repeated twice and pooled, n=12 (growth) / n=8 (enzymes, ABA, qPCR).
system: greenhouse pot

description: Tomato (Solanum lycopersicum var. muchamiel) greenhouse pot experiment, randomized complete block design, 3 inoculation treatments (non-inoculated control, Zopfiella aff. erostrata strain 1, Z. aff. erostrata strain 2; ten colonized barley seeds per pot at transplanting) x 2 watering regimes (well-watered 100% water-holding capacity; drought 60-50% field capacity during the last two weeks before harvest). One seedling per 1 kg pot of sterilized loamy soil:quartz sand 1:1, 25/15 C, 16 h photoperiod. Single destructive harvest after seven weeks; shoot and root dry weight (Figure 1b,d). Parallel wheat experiment out of scope and not mapped. Replication conflict (ten vs four vs six) unresolved.
system: greenhouse pot

description: Greenhouse pot experiment (Islamic Azad University of Isfahan, February 2016), completely randomized factorial design with 3 replicates: 7 seed treatments (S control, S.N, S.B, S.E, S.B.N, S.E.N, S.E.B.N) x 5 irrigation water salinities (0.3, 2, 4, 6, 8 dS/m) = 35 cells; 105 pots (20 cm, 4 kg sandy loam), one seed/seedling per pot. Root/shoot fresh and dry weight (mg per seedling), proline and antioxidant enzymes measured 15 days after treatments. S.E at 8 dS/m: no surviving seedlings, source declares no data. No fruit yield (seedling stage).
system: greenhouse pot (soil)

description: Greenhouse late-blight biocontrol assay (Methods p3 'Inhibition Assay in Greenhouse'; Table 3 p5). Tomato cv. Cool seedlings raised 2 weeks in 50-hole trays, transplanted singly to 15 cm pots (commercial soil Baroker + 10% perlite), greenhouse 60% RH, 28 +/- 2 C day / 25 C night, watered daily. Bacterial isolate applied once as soil drench, 100 ml of 1e7 spores/ml per pot, 7 days before infection (soil only). P. infestans KACC 43070 zoospores 1.0e7/ml in 0.04% Tween 80 sprayed to runoff, 5 ml/seedling; 12 h high humidity before and after. Water-treated plants with or without pathogen as controls. Plants removed eight weeks later; shoot fresh/dry weight, percent leaf necrosis, percent disease suppression. Six plants per treatment, one plant per pot; experiments repeated twice (Table 3 footnote). ANOVA as completely randomized design, Duncan test. 9 arms: 7 isolate+pathogen (SB), pathogen-only Control a (S), non-inoculated Control b (C). No bacteria-only arm, so not a factorial.
system: greenhouse pot, 15 cm pot, single plant per pot, commercial soil with 10% perlite

description: Unstressed greenhouse PGPR growth-promotion assay (Methods p3 'PGPR assay in greenhouse'; Table 4 p6). Tomato seedlings (cultivar not restated in this section) raised 2 weeks in 50-hole trays then transplanted singly to 15 cm pots (Baroker + 10% perlite); greenhouse 28 +/- 2 C, watered twice daily. Bacterial inoculum 1e8-1e9 CFU/ml applied as soil drench twice, one week apart (volume per pot not stated); no pathogen. Harvest 3 weeks after the last inoculation; shoot/root length, shoot/root fresh and dry weight, SPAD vs non-inoculated control. 8 arms: 7 isolates (B) and non-inoculated Control (C). Replication/design reported inconsistently: Methods 'one replicate and three replications ... randomized block design'; Table 4 footnote 'individual trial, with six replicates per treatment ... repeated twice ... single pot with one plant per pot'; Statistics 'completely randomized design'. Recorded exactly, unresolved.
system: greenhouse pot, 15 cm pot, single plant per pot, commercial soil with 10% perlite

description: Single growth-chamber pot experiment, tomato cv. Pusa Sheetal, 40-day-old seedlings. Temperature factor: 25/18 C day/night control vs low temperature 10/3 C day/night for 24 h. Foliar MeJA factor: 0, J1 (0.5 uM per Abstract/Methods vs 5 uM per figure captions, unresolved), J2 10 uM, J3 15 uM, applied before, during and after stress. After the 24 h stress plants kept 3 days at 25/18 +/- 3 C, RH 75 percent, then sampled destructively. Three replicates of plants per group, mean and SD, ANOVA with Dunnett test. 8 arms: Con, LT, J1, J2, J3, J1C, J2C, J3C.
system: growth chamber, containers with soil (pH 6.3) of peat:compost 4:1 v/v mixed with sand 3:1 v/v

description: Open-field processing tomato (Heinz 3406), San Polo (Piacenza, Italy), 2020: randomised block design with 4 blocks, factorial 3 irrigation levels (25, 50, 100% PAW, drip; irrigation levels laid out as contiguous columns in Fig. 1) x 3 Vegetal B60 foliar biostimulant levels (T0 untreated, T1 treated twice, T2 treated three times at 37/52/65 DAT; 6 kg/ha in 300 L/ha); single final harvest 25-28 Aug 2020 on 3 x 1 m2 per plot.
system: Open field, drip irrigation, UAV multispectral phenotyping

description: Greenhouse pot experiment (Methods 2.2.1-2.3, p2-p3): tomato cv. Guofen 1 in 15 x 12 cm pots of Eum-Orthric Anthrosol field soil from Yangling, Shaanxi, China, 28 C, ~12 h sunlight, one seedling per pot. Single soil drench at first true leaf: 100 mL of 100-fold diluted Ba13 suspension ('10^8 CFU mL-1' as printed) vs 100 mL of 100-fold diluted beef-extract-peptone broth (control). Both groups exposed to whiteflies in a greenhouse for 3 days at 3 wpbi for natural TYLCV infection. Two groups only (TYLCV alone; Ba13 + TYLCV), 100 plants each, random distribution. Outcomes: growth at 3 and 7 wpbi (Fig. 2, n=32), root scanning 3 wpbi (Fig. 3), virus DNA 14 dpvi (Fig. 1b, 3 replicates), disease incidence/index 14 and 28 dpvi (Table 2, 32 plants in 3 replicate groups of 11/11/10), enzymes and PR genes 1-10 dpvi, rhizosphere culturable microbes 7 wpbi (Tables 3-6).
system: greenhouse pot, soil

description: In vitro seed germination test (Methods 2.8.1, p4; Fig. 6, p9): tomato cv. Guofen 1 seeds (and cabbage, not mapped) surface-sterilized, soaked 15 h in B. velezensis B3 cell-free culture filtrate diluted 0- (undiluted), 10-, 100- or 1000-fold, or sterile water (control); 15 seeds per Petri dish on filter paper, 3 dishes per treatment, 5 mL sterile water per day; radicle and hypocotyl length measured in tomato 12 days later. No stress factor; context only (no target endpoint). Fig. 6 caption reports 15 replicates (seedlings within dishes).
system: Petri dish, filter paper, seedlings

description: Resistance-related gene expression assay with B. velezensis B3 cell-free culture filtrate (Methods 2.8.3, p4; Fig. 7, p10): NPR1, PR2, PR3 expression in tomato leaves after treatment with 10-, 100- or 1000-fold diluted B3 filtrate vs sterile water control; application route, plant stage, timing and sampling time are not stated. Fig. 7 caption: three replicates. No stress factor; context only (no target endpoint).
system: tomato seedlings, growth system not stated

description: Fig. 1A (p4): soil/incubation temperature gradient 20, 25, 30, 35 C at -5 kPa; 4 seed-inoculation treatments (1% CMC uninoculated control, Azospirillum sp., Azotobacter chroococcum, Pseudomonas fluorescens) x 4 temperatures; tomato cv. Pusa-ruby, 5 seeds per pot in 500 g unsterilized sandy loam, growth chamber; plant dry weight ('values x 100 mg dry wt', mean of 20 replicates, basis and harvest age not stated). 25 C is the non-stress reference.
system: growth chamber pots, unsterilized field sandy loam soil (Varanasi, India)

description: Fig. 1B (p4): soil matric potential gradient 0, -5, -10, -15 kPa at 25 C; same 4 seed-inoculation treatments x 4 moisture levels; tomato cv. Pusa-ruby, 5 seeds per pot in 500 g unsterilized sandy loam, growth chamber; plant dry weight ('values x 100 mg dry wt', mean of 20 replicates, basis and harvest age not stated). -5 kPa is the non-stress reference; nominally identical to E1 25 C condition but not stated to be the same pots and bars are not identical, so kept separate.
system: growth chamber pots, unsterilized field sandy loam soil (Varanasi, India)

description: Table 1 (p5), Methods 'Disease reduction' (p3): Rhizoctonia solani AG4 damping-off assay; seed+root inoculated seedlings (Azospirillum sp., A. chroococcum, P. fluorescens) vs uninoculated control, 5 seedlings per pot, all in field soil mixed with R. solani maize meal inoculum (5% w/w, 8.1 x 1e4 cfu g-1), growth chamber 25 +/- 2 C, -5 kPa, assessed after 28 d; disease index (1-5) and diseased plants (%), +/- unlabelled; RCBD 20 replicates x 5 plants. No pathogen-free control.
system: growth chamber pots, R. solani-infested unsterilized field soil

description: Growth-promotion pot experiment without pathogen (Table 5, physical PDF p10 / journal p439; Methods physical p5 / journal p434): 30-day-old tomato seedlings in sterilized loamy soil drenched with 10 ml culture filtrate or 10 ml cell suspension (10^7 cfu/ml) of Bacillus B.PNR1 or B.PNR2 at days 7, 14, 21, 28 vs mock control; total/shoot/root length and Total/Shoot/Root DW (g) at day 35. CRD, 5 replicates (replicate unit undefined), performed twice, pooling not stated.
system: Pot, sterilized loamy soil, tomato cultivar not reported, no pathogen

description: Fusarium wilt biocontrol pot experiment (Table 3, physical PDF p9 / journal p438; Methods physical p4 / journal p433; Fig. 3 physical p8): 30-day-old tomato seedlings in sterilized loamy soil; Fol TFPK401 race 1 root-wound drench inoculation (10 ml, 10^6 conidia/ml); Bacillus B.PNR1 or B.PNR2 as 10 ml culture filtrate or 10 ml cell suspension (10^7 cfu/ml) root-crown drench, approach A (48 h before Fol, then weekly for 4 weeks) or approach B (48 h after Fol, then weekly for 4 weeks); Control A mock, Control B Fol only; DSS (1-5, mean +/- SD) and derived DSI/DC at 35 days after Fol inoculation. Authors: Factorial in CRD, 5 replicates (unit undefined), performed twice, pooling not stated. Control rows printed identically under all four approach x form column groups; shared vs separate control sets UNRESOLVED, modelled as one shared Control A and one shared Control B arm.
system: Pot, sterilized loamy soil, tomato cultivar not reported, Fusarium oxysporum f. sp. lycopersici TFPK401

description: Field experiment, tomato cv. PKM-1, Horticultural College and Research Institute (TNAU), Periyakulam, India, sandy loam Alfisol; 2 x 4 factorial randomized block design: AM fungus Glomus intraradices TNAU 120-02 nursery inoculation (M+) vs non-inoculated (M-) x four drought intensities by irrigation scheduling at IW/CPE 0.50 (I1 severe), 0.75 (I2 moderate), 1.00 (I3 mild), 1.25 (I4 no drought/well watered); 4 replicate plots of 20 m2, five tagged plants per plot; repeated in 2002 and 2003 growing seasons (season held on arms; Fig. 1 and Fig. 7 season UNSPECIFIED).
system: open field, flood irrigation, randomized complete block

description: Pot experiment, tomato cv. Chaoyan 219 seedlings in natural loam soil; 2x2 factorial of inoculation (uninoculated vs Streptomyces sp. TOR3209 cell suspension soil drench 10^7 CFU/g at transplanting) x temperature (25 C vs 5 C for 10 d starting day 30 after inoculation). Shoot fresh and dry weight measured at 10 d post low-temperature treatment (Fig. 1b). Experiment tested three times with three plant replicates per repeat; Fig. 1 bars = mean of triplicate experiments +/- SD (physical p4 Methods, p8 caption).
system: Pot, natural loam soil, greenhouse (Hebei Academy of Agriculture and Forestry Sciences, Shijiazhuang); cold treatment facility not specified

description: Greenhouse pot experiment (Alexandria University, Egypt, autumn 2021): cherry tomato 'Golden Cherry' hybrid; 2 F. solani soil infestation levels (without; with 1e3 conidia/g soil) as main plots x 4 Trichoderma subplot treatments (T0 sterile water dip; T1 T. viride; T2 T. harzianum; TMix1+2 mixture) applied as root dip 1e7 conidia/mL 15 min at transplanting plus soil drench 1e6 conidia/g soil at 15 and 30 DAT; RCBD split-plot, 5 replicates, 40 plots; destructive sampling at 45 DAT (fresh/dry weights, leaf nutrients, pigments, phenolics, disease incidence index).
system: greenhouse pots, sterilized sandy loam-peat moss 2:1 v/v, 20 cm pots, half-strength modified Hoagland drip fertigation

description: Hydroponic tomato seedling experiment (10 L half-strength Hoagland, pH 6.2), complete 2x2 factorial: NaCl 0 vs 125 mM in nutrient solution x foliar distilled water vs foliar 100 uM melatonin (both leaf sides, every 2 days at 5.00 p.m. for 7 days), treatments from the three-leaf stage, sampling 7 days after treatment start. Triplicate randomized block design, at least 15 seedlings per treatment, figure values mean +/- SE of three replications (Methods: at least n = 3).
system: hydroponic tank, half-strength Hoagland nutrient solution, aerated

description: Greenhouse pot experiment, tomato cv. Fenli seedlings in vermiculite pots (one seedling per pot, Hoagland solution 80 mL per plant at 2-day interval, 25 C +/- 5, 55-90% RH). Treatments started after 10-day pre-cultivation at four-true-leaf stage: CK full watering, DR water withholding up to two weeks after eight days full watering, ME+DR 100 uM melatonin pretreatment (80 mL per plant, four times at 2-day interval) then water withholding up to two weeks. 3 replicates x 8 plants per treatment, one-way ANOVA with LSD. No melatonin-only well-watered arm (C/S/SB design). Sources p3 sections 2.1-2.3 (receipt SRC-b23c7aa2d51c15bbdc25446f), p5 section 2.10 (receipt SRC-150ea80e5bd4b710e163374a), p6 Fig. 1-2 (SRC-163a333dea632b1db05fb673).
system: greenhouse pot, vermiculite substrate, seedlings

description: Single greenhouse experiment Sep 2019-Jan 2020, Agricultural University of Athens heated glasshouse (2 compartments), open hydroponic rockwool, tomato cv. Nostymi F1 grafted on BIL-6335; 2 stress levels (No stress optimal fertigation ~20% drainage; Combined water+nutrient stress, reduced NS volume and concentration) x 4 biostimulant levels (Control, Edypro, strigolactone-based BS, Maxicrop); completely randomized block design, 4 replicates x 9 plants per treatment combination, 2 replicates per compartment (p5). Yield (Table 4) reported only as main-effect marginal means.
system: heated glasshouse, open hydroponic system, rockwool slabs, 2.25 plants m-2

description: Small-scale soil pot experiment in plant growth chamber: 7-day old tomato seedlings inoculated (10^8 cells per g soil) with one of four ACC deaminase rhizobacteria or uninoculated, grown 7 days at 20% of soil water-holding capacity, whole plants harvested for root length, stem length and dry weight (Figs. 3-4). 3 containers x 4 seedlings per treatment.
system: plant growth chamber, plastic containers (7.5 cm diameter, 250 g soil:compost 70:30)

description: Roll towel seedling growth assay, tomato cv. Packmore, 5 salt-tolerant rhizobacterial strains (A. faecalis BTR4.4, P. aeruginosa BTR7.0 and BTR8.6, S. marcescens BTR1.0 and BTR1.1) vs uninoculated control, no NaCl and no pathogen; germination, shoot/root length, vigour index after 15 days (Table 2, mean +- SE, 4 replicates x 25 seeds).
system: laboratory roll towel assay

description: Greenhouse pot experiment, tomato cv. Packmore: 5 talc-formulated strains + P. aphanidermatum, infected (pathogen only) control and uninfected (non-infested soil) control, each at 0, 50 and 100 mM NaCl irrigation for 3 weeks; percent seedling mortality (damping-off) after 3 wk (Table 3, mean +- SE of 5 replications, replication = 4 pots x 12 seeds); experiment repeated twice, pooling not stated.
system: greenhouse pots, sterilised potting mix

description: In vivo growth-room experiment (Methods 2.4.1): one-month-old Raf tomato seedlings inoculated with D. abyssi MT1.1T (10^8-10^9 CFU/mL in 0.5 M9 buffer) and subjected to 150 mM NaCl at day 0; non-inoculated seedlings with and without salinity as controls; sampled 14 days after inoculation; 3 replicates (unit not stated); one-way ANOVA CRD with Duncan test; mean and SD. Arms C (-NaCl), S (+NaCl), SB (MT1.1T + 150 mM NaCl); no inoculated no-salt arm (data not shown).
system: Growth room, pots/substrate not stated; RH 50-60%, 12 h photoperiod, 18-20 C night, 20-25 C day

description: Experiment 1 (Methods 2.3): 'Impacts of AMF-1 and AMF-2 on biomass production of tomatoes under saline stress'. Potted greenhouse experiment, Tainan District Agricultural Research and Extension Station, Taiwan; seedlings transplanted 8 October (year not stated) into pots with 7 kg air-dried sandy loam. Cultivars TSS7 and TCAV10, each a 2^3 factorial (saline stress x AMF-1 Claroideoglomus etunicatum x AMF-2 Funneliformis mosseae) 'separately with each hybrid cultivar', RCBD, three replications. Saline stress = NaCl (20 g L-1) weekly at 10 mL pot-1. Inoculum = 2 g soil (~100 spores g-1) containing AMF-1 or/and AMF-2 mixed with basal medium. Single destructive harvest 'after six weeks of transplanting'; shoot and root fresh and dry weight (70 C, 72 h) and moisture, Fig. 1a (TSS7) and 1b (TCAV10), means +/- SD n=3. Targets: shoot dry weight (shoot fallback) and root dry weight (root-only, separate); fresh weights and moisture not targets. No fruit yield in E1.
system: greenhouse pot, 7 kg air-dried sandy loam soil per pot, Tainan DARES greenhouse, Taiwan

description: Experiment 2 (Methods 2.4): 'Inoculation of hybrid tomato cultivars with AMF-2 under saline stress'. Conducted 'during the following year' on 6 February in the same greenhouse; same soil/pot system (7 kg air-dried sandy loam). 2^3 factorial: hybrid cultivar (TSS7, TCAV10) x saline stress (none; NaCl 20 g L-1 weekly at 10 mL pot-1) x AMF-2 (none; F. mosseae 2 g soil inoculum ~100 spores g-1), RCBD, three replications (Methods 2.6; Table 4 three-factor F-values). Treatments per cultivar: Control, AMF-2, Saline stress, Saline stress+AMF-2. ~400 mL pot-1 half-strength Yamazaki nutrient solution at transplanting, full strength during fruiting; four fruits retained per inflorescence. 'Samples for the analysis and estimation of yield were collected four months after transplanting'. Target: Table 1 fresh fruit 'Yield (g plant-1)', Duncan letters only, no dispersion; cumulative vs single picking not stated. Context: Table 1 juice ratio/Brix, Table 2 tissue nutrients, Table 3 soil at harvest, Table 4 F-values, Fig. 2 colonization, Fig. 3 relative permeability.
system: greenhouse pot, 7 kg air-dried sandy loam soil per pot, same Tainan DARES greenhouse, Taiwan

description: Root coating experiment: tomato cv. Bonny Best seedlings at the three-leaf stage removed from Vermiculite, roots washed and dipped 5-10 min in purified crab-shell chitosan 0.5, 1.0 or 2 mg ml-1 (in water + 0.01% Tween 80, pH 5.6) or in sterile distilled water amended with Tween 80 (control); air dried 1 h at 22 C, repotted in Vermiculite; one day after chitosan treatment inoculated with discs of actively growing mycelium of F. oxysporum f. sp. radicis-lycopersici placed close to the root system; control plants received fungus-free agar medium discs; some chitosan-treated plants not inoculated. Roots examined daily for visible necrotic lesions (Table 1, days 1-6 after inoculation, five main roots per chitosan treatment per day, SE in parentheses) and sampled 4 days after inoculation for microscopy (Table 2 and Table 3 Root rows, context only). Five plants per treatment, experiment repeated twice. Glasshouse, soil temperature about 22 C, RH 75%.
system: glasshouse pots, Vermiculite substrate, seedlings (6 cm pots, 5 seeds per pot at sowing)

description: Leaf application experiment: fully expanded true leaves of each of five tomato seedlings sprayed or rubbed (celite abrasive) with chitosan 1 mg ml-1; control plants sprayed or rubbed with sterile distilled water; kept 3 days in glasshouse at 22 C, then inoculated at root level with Forl mycelial discs; root samples collected four days after inoculation for light and electron microscopy only (Table 2 and Table 3 Leaf rows: papillae number and gold labelling density, context). No root lesion counts reported for this experiment.
system: glasshouse pots, Vermiculite substrate, seedlings

description: Experiment 1 (morphology/physiology): greenhouse pot experiment, tomato cv. ACE55, 2x2 factorial A. brasilense BNM65 seed inoculation (pre-treated or not) x C. michiganensis subsp. michiganensis Cm9 inoculation 5 weeks after sowing (inoculated or mock SDW), completely randomized design, one plant per 300 ml pot, seven plants per treatment, harvested 70 days after sowing; dry weight of leaves, stems, roots, total biomass, height, stem surface (Table 1), shoot:root, leaf area, SLA (Fig 1), hydraulic conductivity (Fig 2), disease severity (text Sec 3.1). Reported as repeated twice; Table 1 n=7 run identity/pooling not stated (gap G1).
system: greenhouse pot (300 ml), substrate Gem 3:perlite:soil 2:1:1

description: Experiment 2 (anatomy): independent experiment with the same four factorial treatments (Untreated, BNM65, Cm9, BNM65 + Cm9); fourth internode stem sections, xylem vessel area and number (Table 2, Fig 3), six plants per treatment; sampling age not reported. No biomass or yield endpoints.
system: greenhouse pot (300 ml), substrate Gem 3:perlite:soil 2:1:1 (general Sec 2.2)

description: Single hydroponic growth-chamber experiment, tomato var. Super 2270 seedlings in 1/2-strength Hoagland; treatments added to 27-day-old seedlings in the nutrient solution (renewed every 3 d): control, melatonin 150 uM, melatonin 150 uM + cPTIO 100 uM, NaCl 150 mM, NaCl + melatonin, NaCl + cPTIO, NaCl + melatonin + cPTIO; plants collected 14 d after treatment start; n = 5 independent replicates, mean +/- SD, one-way ANOVA LSD.
system: HYDROPONIC_GROWTH_CHAMBER

description: Glasshouse aerated solution-culture experiment (Hoagland's nutrient solution), Faisalabad, February-April 2012: two tomato cultivars (Nagina salt-tolerant, Peto-86 salt-sensitive) x potassium 4.5 mM (recommended) or 9.0 mM (double dose), maintained using KNO3 x NaCl 0, 75 or 150 mM; completely randomized design, three replicates; shoot and root dry weight at 30 days after salt treatment.
system: glasshouse; aerated hydroponic solution culture (Hoagland's nutrient solution)

description: Pot experiment, tomato cvs Behta (salt-sensitive) and Piazar (more salt tolerant) x soil salinity (control EC 0.63, low 5, high 10 dSm-1 via NaCl added gradually during 2 weeks after transplanting) x mycorrhiza (-AMF sterilized inoculum, +AMF Glomus intraradices pre-colonized 3 weeks in nursery); one seedling per autoclaved 5 L pot, sandy loam soil (91 mg urea, 174 mg K2SO4 kg-1, no P), 12 weeks under controlled conditions 25/18 C, 14/10 h; complete randomized block design, 4 replications; three-way ANOVA (C, S, M and all interactions); single terminal harvest for shoot and root dry weight.
system: pot, controlled environment

description: Greenhouse pot experiment, Shiraz University, Iran: tomato cv. Falcato, one plant per pot in cocopeat/perlite fertigated with nutrient solution; complete 3 x 5 factorial NaCl (0, 25, 50 mM, added to NS from 14 days after transplanting in three steps) x Si treatment (NSc, 1 mM Si, 2 mM Si, 1 mM N-Si, 2 mM N-Si added to NS), six replications, two-way ANOVA, plants grown 42 days after Si/N-Si and NaCl addition then harvested.
system: greenhouse, pots with cocopeat/perlite (1/1 v/v), open fertigation with nutrient solution (described as hydroponics in abstract)

description: Hydroponic growth-chamber experiment (continuously aerated Hoagland solution, 1 L pots, 4 plants per pot, 150 umol m-2 s-1, 16 h photoperiod, 25/20 C). Two tomato cultivars (Rio Grande, Moneymaker) x 6 treatments (Table 1): Control, Si1 = CaSiO3 2 mM, Si2 = CaSiO3 4 mM, NaCl 100 mM (25 mM per day increments), Si1+NaCl, Si2+NaCl; Si as calcium silicate through the root growing medium. Treatments started at the third-leaf stage (after 10 d germination + 10 d acclimatization) for 15 days; single harvest at 35 days old, separated into leaves, stems, roots; DW after 70 C 48 h.
system: hydroponic nutrient solution, growth chamber

description: Phase 1 seed germination test, 1.5 mL volume level: tomato hybrid Super Star seeds in peat moss, 10 seedlings x four replicates per treatment, treatments T1-T10 (labels as Table 1) given at 1.5 mL at a four-day interval, germinated seeds counted every four days for 20 days (Methods p2, Figure 1 p4). Context only; no TFM target endpoint.
system: peat moss germination media, 20 days

description: Phase 1 seed germination test, 2.5 mL volume level: same protocol as E1 with 2.5 mL of each treatment T1-T10 (Methods p2, Figure 1 p4). Context only; no TFM target endpoint.
system: peat moss germination media, 20 days

description: Phase 1 seed germination test, 5 mL volume level: same protocol as E1 with 5 mL of each treatment T1-T10 (Methods p2, Figure 1 p4). Context only; no TFM target endpoint.
system: peat moss germination media, 20 days

description: Phase 2 100-day growth assessment: tomato hybrid Super Star grown in polybags with growth media 3:2:1 (top soil: sand: compost), completely randomised design block (CRBD), ten treatments T1-T10 (Table 1), 40 ml per plant pot applied once a week; outcomes plant height and stem diameter at day 100 after transplanting, SPAD weeks 4-14, flower and fruit counts until final harvesting (100 days), vascular bundle size. Number of blocks/replicates not stated. No fruit-yield mass or dry biomass reported.
system: polybag, top soil:sand:compost 3:2:1, 'field assessment' (location not stated)

description: Pot experiment: tomato cv. Sahal, 25-day-old seedlings transplanted into earthen pots (12 kg silt loam soil), thinned to one plant per pot after 15 days; irrigation with tap water or untreated wastewater (800 mL per application); wastewater-irrigated pots received 0, 25, 50 or 75 mg Si kg-1 soil as sodium silicate; 5 treatments, completely randomized design with five replications; destructive harvest 50 days after transplanting (leaves, stems, roots oven dry matter, metal concentrations, post-harvest soil metals).
system: POT

description: Growth-chamber pot experiment, tomato genotype HYT (bacterial wilt-susceptible), two treatments both inoculated with Ralstonia solanacearum race 1 biovar 3 (15 mL of 10^8 CFU mL-1 infused into each pot at the six-leaf stage): -Si (nutrient solution without soluble Si, K replenished with KCl; control) and +Si (nutrient solution with 2 mM potassium silicate), irrigated daily 30 mL pH 6.5. Three replicates of 12 plants per treatment. Disease index daily 1-7 dpi (repeated on same plant sets); destructive sampling of three random plants per treatment at 1, 2, 3, 7 dpi (bacterial population and Si content in roots/midstems or stems/leaves at 1, 3, 7 dpi). Methods 5.1-5.3, p14.
system: growth chamber, pots 170 mm diameter x 165 mm height, peat-based substrate (Klasmann)

description: Open-field processing tomato 'Uno Rosso' F1 experiment, Szent Istvan University Institute of Horticulture farm, Godollo, Hungary, 2015. Full 3x3 factorial: water supply W100 (full/optimum drip, 426.3 mm total), W50 (half/deficit drip, 306.3 mm total), W0 (rainfed, 186.3 mm precipitation only) x Phylazonit PGPR (Control non-inoculated; Phyl+ seedling substrate inoculation; Phyl++ seedling inoculation plus post-transplant reinoculation with 1% solution via drip). Randomized complete block design, four replications per treatment; twin rows, 1.2 m bed centres, 0.4 m between twin rows, 0.2 m between plants. Single harvest August 25. Tukey HSD and two-way ANOVA (Phyl, W, PhylxW).
system: OPEN_FIELD

description: Greenhouse pot experiment, tomato cv. Peto 86, sterile soil in 20 cm plastic pots, 28 +/- 2 C, RH 75 +/- 5%, 14/10 h light/dark; one-way layout of 5 treatments (T1 control, T2 R. solani Rs33 1% w/w soil, T3 T. asperelloides Ta41 10 mL 1e8 spores/mL per pot, T4 Ta41 48 h before Rs33, T5 Ta41 48 h after Rs33) x 5 replicates; assessed one month after transplanting (Methods 2.3, p3-4).

Nador F1 on a naturally saline silt loam field (soil EC 'on the order of 1.2 mScm-1'), Bou-Areg plain, Nador, Morocco (p.73); half-hectare field, no added fertilizer, irrigation by impoundment 1 h/day, 30-day-old 3-4-leaf transplants treated with Difenoconazole before irrigation (both arms).
