Expected Table 2 inventory = 2 arms x 3 size classes = 6 cells at E1.T_HARV_TOTAL; size classes share plants within arm (dependency cluster). Source limitations not resolvable by design: season/year, harvest end date and number of harvests not reported; Table 2 footnote y calls the cells 'Means' but does not state the unit averaged over or the n per cell (denominator printed as per 10 plants = one replicate unit); marketable/non-marketable scope of grades not stated; fresh basis not stated explicitly (weighed in situ, no drying described); Methods mention 'yield and biomass of tomato fruits in situ' but no biomass values are printed; Results prose conflicts with Table 2 (TB-V2 small 15.75 vs 15.7, medium/large swapped; Table 1 firmness/pH prose differs), table cells authoritative. Salinity is a shared site background, not a manipulated factor; no non-saline control, so only S vs SB is available. Not factorial.
system: open_field

description: Greenhouse pot experiment at University of Lahore, Lahore, Pakistan, Sep-Dec 2020. Tomato (cultivar not named; seedlings from VRI Faisalabad) transplanted at the 2-3 leaf stage into plastic pots with 20 kg loam:compost:organic manure soil (3:1:1). CRD with factorial arrangement: irrigation 100% FC (control) vs 60% FC (drought, imposed at vegetative stage and maintained until harvesting) x foliar nano-nutrient solution of biochar (NNS, Shaanxi Dainong Huitai) at 0, 1, 3 and 5%, applied three times 5 d apart starting two weeks after drought onset, at vegetative stage. 3 replications per treatment. Physiology/biochemistry sampled 20 d after foliar application; growth, yield and biomass recorded at maturity (Tables 1A/1B). Two-way ANOVA (D, F, DxF).
system: greenhouse pot

description: Autumn 2021 greenhouse season (transplanted 25 Aug 2021, uprooted 12 Jan 2022), Yangling, China, tomato cv. Jinpeng 101, drip irrigation under plastic film mulch, clay loam. Full factorial 3 irrigation levels (I1 90-100%, I2 70-80%, I3 50-60% field capacity) x 2 soil salinity levels (S0 0.1%, S1 0.4% g/g by NaCl) x 2 silicon rates (T0 0 mM, T1 2.4 mM Si Fluid Silicon, 4.3 L/plot every 10 d, alternating drip/foliar); 12 cells x 3 plots (n=3). Irrigation totals I1/I2/I3 = 237/183/125 mm (Fig. 1 caption).
system: greenhouse soil plots, drip irrigation under plastic film mulch

description: Spring 2022 greenhouse season (transplanted 15 Mar 2022, uprooted 3 Jul 2022), same greenhouse, cultivar, management and the same 3 irrigation x 2 salinity x 2 silicon full factorial; 12 cells x 3 plots (n=3). Irrigation totals I1/I2/I3 = 273/215/140 mm (Fig. 1 caption). Possible plot reuse across seasons not stated; keep in same dependency cluster as E1.
system: greenhouse soil plots, drip irrigation under plastic film mulch

description: Grape tomato cv. T309 pot experiment in polyhouse, Asian Institute of Technology, Bangkok, Thailand, 2020-2021; 15 kg Bangkok clay soil per pot, 1 plant per pot. Completely randomized design, 7 fertilizer doses (T1 100% NP control; T2 100% NP+100% OM; T3 100% NP+100% Si; T4 100% NP+100% OM+100% Si; T5 75% NP+25% OM+100% Si; T6 50% NP+50% OM+100% Si; T7 100% OM+100% Si; 100% OM = cow dung manure 10 t/ha, 100% Si = monosilicic acid 20% Si 300 kg/ha, soil-applied) fully crossed with 3 soil moisture regimes (100%, 75%, 50% field capacity from 15 DAT), 4 replicate pots per combination; two-way ANOVA; data mean +/- SE (n=4).
system: polyhouse pot

description: Pot experiment, tomato cv. Sandhal, 40 pots of 20 kg clay loam soil (5 pots per treatment, 2 seedlings per pot: one harvested before flowering for ions, one grown to maturity for growth/yield). All pots irrigated weekly with 1.5 L municipal wastewater (MWW). Eight treatments T1-T8 = complete combination set of Si (potassium silicate, 120 mg Si kg-1 soil), FYM (cattle farmyard manure 10 g kg-1 soil = 20 t ha-1, incorporated 40 d before transplanting) and PGPR (Serratia marcescens SF3, method of Shahzad et al. [23]); identical basal NPK (50 mg N, 35 mg P2O5, 35 mg K2O per kg soil). Pakistan (growing environment not stated). One-way LSD, n=5 per treatment; no non-MWW control.
system: pot experiment (growing environment not stated)

description: Single semi-controlled greenhouse pot experiment, tomato cv. Campbell 33: 2x2 AMF (R. irregularis DAOM 197198, 30 g inoculum at sowing vs mock filtered inoculum + non-mycorrhizal maize roots) x compost (olive pomace/olive mill wastewater compost 5% w/w mixed into soil at transplanting vs none) crossed with water regime (WW 75% FC vs DS 35% FC, imposed after 1 month at 75% FC) = genuine 2x2x2 factorial; plus an extra conventional NPK fertilizer reference arm at both water regimes (separate background, not a biostimulant). Final assessment after 4 months; mean +/- SE of five independent biological replicates per cell (Methods 4.2, 4.3, 4.6.4; Table 1 p4).
system: semi-controlled greenhouse, natural light (410 umol m-2 s-1), 25.5 C, 68.5% RH; plastic pots with 5 kg sterilized soil (pH 8.2, 1% OM), pots rearranged weekly

description: Tomato cv. Season 9 (Thai hybrid) pot experiment, naturally lit polyhouse, AIT Klong Luang, Pathum Thani, Thailand, Jul-Nov 2021. CRD factorial (Methods 2.2, PDF p3): 6 treatment groups [ASE0+Si0 control; ASE0+Si60; ASE1.25/2.5/3.75/5 mL L-1 + Si 60 kg ha-1] x 3 soil moisture regimes (50%, 75%, 100% FC; gravimetric, daily SM150 correction) = 18 cells, 4 single-plant pots per cell (each pot = one replication; two-way ANOVA, LSD). Si-alone and ASE+Si arms are present, but there is no ASE-alone arm, so ASE x Si is not factorial; factorial_verified refers to the (ASE+Si group) x moisture factorial. Marginal group/moisture rows in Tables 2-3 are pooled means, not cells. Shared comparators (ASE0+Si0, ASE0+Si60 at each FC) form dependency clusters.
system: Pot (15 kg Bangkok clay soil, 30 cm high pots), naturally lit polyhouse, 28-34 C, RH 70-75%

description: Summer 2021 open-field trial, Isna (Aswan, Egypt), hybrid H1 Nirouz (TH99806) main plots. Four foliar sub-plot treatments: CK (H2O), P3 potassium silicate 3 mL/L, F2 fulvic acid 2 mL/L and P3+F2, each sprayed at 30/50/70 DAT. Split-plot RCBD with 3 replicates (n=3 plots per cell). Treatment sub-plots share the hybrid main plot within each block, so allocation is CLUSTERED. Factorial: the authors state an explicit 2-factor design (hybrid x treatment), and the treatment set gives complete separately randomized CK/A/B/AB cells for potassium silicate x fulvic acid at identical doses.
system: open field

description: Summer 2021 open-field trial, Isna (Aswan, Egypt), hybrid H2 '023' main plots. Four foliar sub-plot treatments: CK (H2O), P3 potassium silicate 3 mL/L, F2 fulvic acid 2 mL/L and P3+F2, each sprayed at 30/50/70 DAT. Split-plot RCBD with 3 replicates (n=3 plots per cell). Treatment sub-plots share the hybrid main plot within each block, so allocation is CLUSTERED. Factorial: the authors state an explicit 2-factor design (hybrid x treatment), and the treatment set gives complete separately randomized CK/A/B/AB cells at identical doses.
system: open field

description: Summer 2022 repeat of the open-field trial, Isna (Aswan, Egypt), hybrid H1 Nirouz (TH99806) main plots, with the same four foliar sub-plot treatments (CK H2O, P3 3 mL/L, F2 2 mL/L, P3+F2) at 30/50/70 DAT. Split-plot RCBD with 3 replicates (n=3 plots per cell). This is an independent new planting (transplanted 14 June 2022), not repeated measures on the 2021 units. Allocation within the season is CLUSTERED (sub-plots within hybrid main plots and blocks). Factorial: explicit hybrid x treatment design with complete CK/A/B/AB treatment cells.
system: open field

description: Summer 2022 repeat of the open-field trial, Isna (Aswan, Egypt), hybrid H2 '023' main plots, with the same four foliar sub-plot treatments (CK H2O, P3 3 mL/L, F2 2 mL/L, P3+F2) at 30/50/70 DAT. Split-plot RCBD with 3 replicates (n=3 plots per cell). Independent new planting in 2022. Allocation within the season is CLUSTERED (sub-plots within hybrid main plots and blocks). Factorial: explicit hybrid x treatment design with complete CK/A/B/AB treatment cells.
system: open field

description: 2019 open-field trial, Battipaglia (Salerno, Italy, Torre Lama farm), tomato genotype E42, transplanted 19 Jun 2019; 2x2 factorial irrigation (100% vs 50% CWR from 22 DAT to end) x biostimulant (untreated vs CycoFlow 3 g/L, 400 mL/plant fertigation at transplant + every 15 d, 4 applications); completely randomized block design, 3 replicates per treatment x 20 plants; harvest from 54 DAT on 6 plants/replicate; two-way ANOVA + Duncan; Figure 1 mean +/- SE.
system: open field, drip irrigation, clay-loam soil

description: 2020 open-field confirmation trial, Apollosa (Benevento, Italy), tomato genotype E42, transplanted May 2020, optimal conditions/standard practices; control vs CycoFlow (same dose and schedule as 2019); completely randomized design, 3 replicates x 10 plants; Student t-test; Table 1 mean +/- SD.
system: open field, clay-loam soil

description: Pot experiment to maturity (110 DAS): tomato var. NP-7715, 30-day seedlings transplanted into clay pots with 4 kg unsterilized sandy clay loam soil (pH 7.2) amended with 0, 20, 200 or 2000 mg kg-1 ZnO-, CuO-, Al2O3- or TiO2-NPs, crossed with Azotobacter salinestris ASM root-dip inoculation (1x10^7 cells/ml, 2 h before transplanting) vs un-inoculated; C1 un-inoculated and C2 inoculated no-NP controls; 26 treatment cells, 3 pots per treatment, 1 plant per pot; open field January-April; NPK basal fertilizer (urea, DAP, MOP at 120/50/50 kg ha-1) applied twice.
system: Pot culture in open field

description: Greenhouse hydroponic tomato seedling experiment (cv. 'Shuangfeng 87-5'; seedlings transplanted at two fully expanded true leaves into 12 L buckets with Hoagland nutrient solution made with 10 L deionized water, pH 6.2 (H2SO4/KOH), solution changed every 3 d; ~14 h light; 24-30 C day / 17-20 C night). After four true leaves, NaCl and Na2SeO3 were added to the nutrient solution for 9 d; four groups established: control (no Se, no NaCl), Se (0.01 mmol/L Na2SeO3), NaCl (100 mmol/L), NaCl+Se (0.01 mmol/L Na2SeO3 + 100 mmol/L NaCl) = complete concurrently randomized 2x2. Randomized block design, three replicates per treatment (plants per replicate not stated); one-way ANOVA with Duncan (Methods) / Tukey (Table 2 footnote); values mean +/- SD. Sources: PDF p.2-4 Methods, p.5 Table 2.
system: greenhouse hydroponic (Hoagland nutrient solution)

description: Tomato var. Rutgers seedlings raised 2 weeks on potting mix in double-decker Magenta boxes, mock-inoculated (sterile/ultrapure water; axenic) or inoculated with Trichoderma harzianum TSTh20-1 conidial suspension, then transplanted to autoclaved petrochemical coarse tailings (CT) and watered with ultrapure water for 2 weeks; fresh and dry weight per seedling at 4 weeks old after washing free of CT (p3, p5 text, Fig 2A photograph; Methods p11). Replication '2 sets of 5 replicate Magenta boxes'. All arms on CT (stress); no non-CT tomato control.
system: Magenta boxes (double-decker, wick-connected), laboratory; growth room/glasshouse not stated

description: Drought-recovery assay: tomatoes grown 6 weeks in potting mix in Magenta boxes with or without TSTh, water withheld 2 d (bottom chambers emptied) to induce wilt, then thoroughly rewatered; leaf water content from leaf disks (five 6 mm disks, one per plant, dried 48 h at 55 C) at end of drought (0 min) and during recovery up to 120 min (p6 text, Fig 3 p7, Methods p12). Both arms droughted; no well-watered control. Outcome is leaf water content only (CONTEXT, not a target endpoint). Whether the same plants were resampled at each recovery time is not stated.
system: Magenta boxes with potting mix, laboratory; growth room/glasshouse not stated

description: ALA concentration experiment (Methods p2; Tables 1-4, Figs 1-3): tomato seedlings with five expanded leaves, cvs Zhongza No. 9 (ZZ, low-temperature tolerant) and Jinpeng No. 1 (JP, sensitive); each plant sprayed with 6 mL distilled water or 5/10/25/50/100 mg/L ALA (with a few drops of Tween 20); 12 h later control kept at 25/18 C day/night, all others transferred to 15/8 C for 6 d; growth indices incl. shoot and root dry weight (Table 4, mean +/- SE, n=7) after 6 d. 2 cultivars x 7 treatments, 30 plants per treatment. TARGET experiment (dry biomass slots #01 shoot, #02 root).
system: controlled-temperature seedling culture (facility not stated; cultivation per Liu et al. 2018a)

description: ALA spray-timing experiment (Methods p2; Fig 4 p8): half of the plants pretreated with 25 mg/L ALA and transferred to 15/8 C 12 h later (ALA->LT); the other half exposed to 15/8 C and immediately sprayed with 25 mg/L ALA (LT->ALA); both cultivars ZZ and JP; MDA, REC and Pn measured 24 h after the low-temperature treatment (mean +/- SE, n=3). No unstressed or chilled-water arm; no target outcomes (CONTEXT only).
system: controlled-temperature seedling culture (facility not stated)

description: ALA dose (spray volume/concentration) experiment (Methods p2; Fig 5 p9): plants pretreated with 6 mL of 25 mg/L ALA (A25), 12 mL of 25 mg/L ALA (A25*2) or 6 mL of 50 mg/L ALA (A50), transferred to 15/8 C after 12 h; both cultivars ZZ and JP; MDA, REC and Pn measured 24 h later (mean +/- SE, n=3). No unstressed or chilled-water arm; no target outcomes (CONTEXT only).
system: controlled-temperature seedling culture (facility not stated)

description: Semi-controlled greenhouse pot experiment (Faculty of Science, Marrakech, Morocco), tomato cv. Campbell 33, one plant per pot in 5 kg sterilized agricultural soil; completely randomized design, 36 treatments = 2 irrigation regimes (75% vs 35% field capacity) x 18 biostimulant treatments (complete crossing of OMWW-compost C yes/no x AMF none/M (R. irregulare DAOM 197198)/M′ (indigenous consortium) x bacteria none/A (actinomycete)/B (Bacillus Z2+Z4 consortium)), 5 biological replicates each, 180 pots; growth variables measured at harvest (Table 3).
system: semi-controlled greenhouse, pots

description: Experiment 1: tomato cv. San Marzano nano in pots (quartz sand 50%, sterile pumice 20%, AMF inoculum or sterile carrier 30%; ~650 g per pot), climatic chamber 23/21 C, 16/8 h. Explicit 3x3 factorial: AM fungus (Ctrl carrier-only, F. mosseae BEG 12, R. intraradices FR 121; MycAgro inoculum, min. 10 propagules/g, at transplant) x water stress (NS container capacity; MS irrigation withheld ~2 weeks, leaf water potential about -0.9 MPa; SS ~3 weeks, petiole water potential < -1.0 MPa), irrigation withheld ~6/7 weeks after inoculation. 12 NS plants per inoculum condition, 24 stressed split over MS/SS. Endpoints: water potential, gas exchange, iWUE, PT gene RT-qPCR (n=3 pooled biological replicates), leaf VOCs (Table 1, NS and SS only), biometrics/CCI (Suppl. Fig S1). No fruit yield or dry biomass. Receipts SRC-8fd3c76f984963db29654870 (p3), SRC-05b8f0e3254a384b6f604980 (p5).
system: controlled-environment pots (climatic chamber)

description: Experiment 2, aphid survival assay (Figure 4): separate set of 20 non-colonized (Ctrl) and 20 R. intraradices-colonized tomato plants; 10 per condition kept well-watered (CtrlNS 'NS', RinNS 'Rin') or under moderate water stress (WS, WS + Rin) - complete 2x2 AMF x water factorial. Every plant infested with one newly born Macrosiphum euphorbiae nymph (uniform background, the measured biotic challenge); daily checks until death of the last individual; Kaplan-Meier survival (R survival 2.41-3), log-rank tests. Receipts SRC-130c167fac07808083fe90e4 (p4), SRC-05b8f0e3254a384b6f604980 (p5), SRC-0acbd135825c5a9076b5fa6d (p9 Fig 4). Source limit recorded (no design change): Methods state 10 plants per condition with one newly born nymph per plant (p4, SRC-130c167fac07808083fe90e4), but Figure 4 step heights (about 0.83, 0.56, 0.50, 0.33, 0.17, 0.11) are not multiples of 1/10, and no censoring is reported or marked (p9, SRC-efbd8db5ad22432337fd3729); aphids at risk and events per arm cannot be verified. Only pooled log-rank P values are reported, with no per-arm median, fixed-day proportion or hazard ratio (p8, SRC-4cafc9f7ca5044faa2011a69).
system: controlled-environment pots; same substrate/inoculation procedure as Experiment 1

description: Experiment 2, parasitoid wind-tunnel and VOC collection assay: 6 plants for each of 8 conditions (NS, Aph, Rin, WS, Rin + Aph, WS + Rin, WS + Aph, WS + Rin + Aph; 48 plants) - complete 2x2x2 AMF (Ctrl vs R. intraradices) x water (NS vs moderate WS) x aphid infestation (50 mixed-aged M. euphorbiae per plant, 1 week feeding; added at onset of water deficit for double stress) factorial. Each plant offered daily for 6 consecutive days in random order to Aphidius ervi (100 females per target, no-choice), then headspace VOC collected. Endpoints context only (Fig 5, Table 2, Fig 6). Receipts SRC-130c167fac07808083fe90e4 (p4), SRC-05b8f0e3254a384b6f604980 (p5).
system: controlled-environment pots; wind tunnel; headspace VOC entrainment

description: Growth-chamber pot experiment with tomato cv. Micro-Tom (one plant per 1.2 L pot, 90% peat/10% perlite, 20-24 C, 60% RH, LED 12 h/day, NPK 20-20-20 twice weekly); randomized complete block design with two blocks; 2 water regimes (WW at pot water capacity; WS at 65% of pot water capacity from 2 weeks after transplant) x 2 foliar products (SOB01 novel calcium-based biostimulant 5 ml/L; SOB02 calcium chloride 10.05 g/L active mineral reference comparator), each 10 ml per plant at BBCH65, BBCH75, BBCH85. No unsprayed control. Fruit dry matter per plant at maturity harvest reported only as product marginal means pooled across water regimes (Fig 4A). Source limit: Methods state 30 plants including 6 biological replicates per condition, which does not reconcile with 4 conditions; per-bar n not printed.
system: controlled growth chamber, pots

description: Application-time stratum 'beginning of flowering' of the single completely randomized 2 (50/100% soil WHC) x 2 (application time) x 6 (control; Seed+; Seed+ + Crop+ 1x; Seed+ + Crop+ 2x; Crop+ 1x; Crop+ 2x) factorial with four repetitions; tomato in 9-L pots (8.5 kg sandy-loam soil), greenhouse, Santa Maria, RS, Brazil; 15-d water deficit after the flowering-stage Crop+ application.
system: greenhouse pot trial

description: Application-time stratum 'beginning of fruiting' of the single completely randomized 2 (50/100% soil WHC) x 2 (application time) x 6 (control; Seed+; Seed+ + Crop+ 1x; Seed+ + Crop+ 2x; Crop+ 1x; Crop+ 2x) factorial with four repetitions; tomato in 9-L pots (8.5 kg sandy-loam soil), greenhouse, Santa Maria, RS, Brazil; 15-d water deficit after the fruiting-stage Crop+ application.
system: greenhouse pot trial

description: Tomato bacterial wilt challenge: soil drench of Mock, BTH (chemical resistance inducer) or Bacillus zanthoxyli HS1 (OD600=0.25, 1 ml/g potting mixture) 7 days before Ralstonia solanacearum soil inoculation (OD600=0.2, 1 ml/g potting mixture); disease incidence (%) from three replicates of six plants, mean +/- SD; experiment repeated twice with same results (Fig. 1A left panel, PDF p2; protocol p3). Source limits: diseased-plant counts and per-arm denominators are not printed (percentages shown graphically only); the time of disease assessment after inoculation is not stated; BTH dose and route are not stated; only one set of bars is shown and the repetition it represents is not stated.
system: potted plants in potting mixture (facility not stated)

description: Tomato cv. Superdotaelang seedling salinity test: 10 mM MgSO4 mock or B. zanthoxyli HS1 (OD600=0.25/g soil) applied to plant-growing soil at 7 das; balanced salinity solution (~-1,000 kPa; 125 mM KNO3, 82 mM Ca(NO3)2, 41 mM MgSO4, 22 mM KH2PO4), 1 ml/g soil at 14, 16 and 18 das; total seedling, root and shoot fresh weight at 28 das; SE from 6 biological replications (n=4 in each experiment) (Fig. 2C, PDF p4; protocol p4-p5). Unstressed arms data not shown.
system: walk-in growth chamber, 26+/-2 C, 12 h day/12 h night, unsterilized BioPlug soil

description: Tomato cv. Campbell greenhouse growth assay with no stress. Seeds were inoculated for 30 min with one of 10 PGPR isolates (Pr5, Pr6, Pr7, Pr8, Pr17, Pr18, Pr26, Pr31, Pr48, Pr50) at 1e8 CFU/mL, or treated with SDW as control, and sown in peat trays. After 15 d plants were transplanted to peat:sand 2:1 bags. Germination was scored at day 7. Stem length, leaf number, leaf area and root fresh weight were recorded at week 5 (Table 2), and chlorophyll, nitrate reductase and proline in 5-week-old plants (Table 3), reported as 95% CI. Methods 2.4, physical p4 (receipt SRC-92dc04997802b884b5ef5b12); Tables 2-3, p6 (SRC-11f2f7a13cd8333d8ea7c736).
system: greenhouse; peat trays then peat:sand 2:1 plastic bags

description: Tomato cv. Campbell salt-stress assay. Seeds were germinated in SDW or in aqueous Pr7 (Pseudomonas stutzeri) or Pr8 (Bacillus toyonensis) formulation at 1e8 CFU/mL. Starting 12 d after emergence, plants received SDW (salinity control) or 150 mM NaCl every 2 d for 12 d. This is a crossed 2x3 factorial. Growth parameters were measured 35 d after the first salt treatment (Table 4, 95% CI, n=10 or n=3), and proline at 0, 3 and 12 d (Fig 4, n=3). The experiment was repeated twice with 10 replicate plants per treatment. Methods 2.5, p4 (SRC-92dc04997802b884b5ef5b12); Table 4, p8 (SRC-f1fcce0135b4bb5b4e36d1a0); Fig 4, p9 (SRC-5cf9d0d8488498cc4e01f6a9).
system: greenhouse pots (as described in Methods 2.4)

description: Tomato cv. Campbell Verticillium wilt disease-suppression assay in the greenhouse. Seedlings from seeds pre-treated with Pr7 or Pr8 at 1e8 CFU/mL, or non-bacterized controls, were unearthed, root-dipped for 10 min in a V. dahliae strain SJ suspension (1e7 conidia/mL) and replanted. Leaf alteration index was scored at 5, 8, 11, 15 and 20 dpi (Fig 3A). Stunting index and browning index were scored at 21 dpi, the end of the experiment (Fig 3B-C). Data are mean and 95% CI from 24 biological replicates, compared with the control by Dunnett test. Methods 2.6, p4 (SRC-92dc04997802b884b5ef5b12); Results 3.5, p6 (SRC-11f2f7a13cd8333d8ea7c736); Fig 3, p8 (SRC-f1fcce0135b4bb5b4e36d1a0). SOURCE LIMIT on the plotted Control: Methods 2.6 p4 (SRC-6442651cccc9009e0a6ee8f1) and the Fig 3 caption p8 (SRC-547247b185306138373070e8) say control roots were dipped in SDW, while Results 3.5 p6 (SRC-b1f6e290f0f9fb9da0680232) describes control plants 'after inoculation' and reports percentage protection relative to them. The paper never explicitly states that the plotted Control received V. dahliae. It is mapped as E3.S on interpretation of Results 3.5 and the disease shown in that series; this is not source confirmation. No data are reported for any separate mock-inoculated arm, and none is mapped.
system: greenhouse

description: Summer 2014 field trial at the Farm of Minia University, clay loam, hot continental climate: 2 tomato hybrids x 4 CANADA HUMEX levels (0, 4.8, 9.6, 14.4 kg/ha) in complete randomized blocks in a split-plot arrangement with 3 replicates; main plots genotype, subplots HA level; 14.40 m2 plots. Heat is ambient for all arms, with no imposed stress and no normal-season reference.
system: summer field

description: Summer 2015 field trial at the Farm of Minia University, clay loam, hot continental climate: 2 tomato hybrids x 4 CANADA HUMEX levels (0, 4.8, 9.6, 14.4 kg/ha) in complete randomized blocks in a split-plot arrangement with 3 replicates; main plots genotype, subplots HA level; 14.40 m2 plots. Heat is ambient for all arms, with no imposed stress and no normal-season reference.

description: Experiment 1 (vegetative): greenhouse pots, Taif agricultural soil, 8 seeds per container, 5 weeks establishment then 14 d drought; complete 2x3 factorial biochar (OB without / WB Wakefield wood biochar 20 g/kg soil) x soil water content (100% control, 75%, 45%); 6 groups x 3 replicate containers, completely randomized design; single destructive sampling on day 14 (leaf area, height, branches, shoot fresh and dry weight).

Replicate count, drought duration and basis not restated (inherited from E1 by 'performed again with a few small differences'). No fruit mass reported.

description: Greenhouse pot experiment (Marrakech region, Morocco): tomato var. Roma VF, one plant per 4.5-l pot with 5 kg agricultural soil (Saada). Completely randomized factorial design: water regime main factor (WW 75% FC vs WS 35% FC, imposed 1 month after transplanting and held 12 more weeks) x 8 fertilization subfactor treatments (Control, Comp, AMF, AMF+Comp, PGPR, PGPR+Comp, PGPR+AMF, PGPR+AMF+Comp) = complete 2x2x2x2 cells; 10 replicate pots per treatment (160 plants); harvest after 4 months. description: Plastic-greenhouse soil experiment, Agricultural Research Center of Ningxia University (Yinchuan, China), 2016, two cropping seasons (winter-spring Jan-Jun; autumn-winter Aug-Dec). Tomato 'Beifan No. 201', drip irrigation under film mulch at 65-105% field capacity with half-strength Yamazaki nutrient solution. Six treatments: fresh-water control; saline water (NS + 2.5 g/L NaCl); SW + straw compost 40 t/ha; SW + FGD gypsum 10 t/ha; SW + straw compost 40 t/ha mixed on site with FGD gypsum 10 t/ha; SW + co-composted FGD gypsum-straw 50 t/ha. Completely randomized design, 3 replicate plots per treatment; fruit yield from 48 inner-row plants per plot over the harvest period; biomass from 12 plants per plot after final harvest.

Faino F1. 3x3 split-plot block design, 3 replicates: irrigation V100/V50/V0 (main plots) x mycorrhiza M0/M1/M2 (subplots 24.3 m2, 108 plants). Transplant 26 May 2008; harvests 12 Aug and 8 Sep 2008. system: open field, drip irrigation (pooled 2008+2009)

description: Exp 1 (section 2.2/3.1, Table 1): Agricola Maresme Vives on-farm plastic greenhouse, tomato cv. Egara, soil beds; 2 x 2 factorial fertilization (Farm usual nutrient solution vs Red reduced N-P-K) x AMF (NM vs Rhizoglomus irregulare 40 g bulk leek-root inoculum per plant under the root system at transplant); four replicates (plots), sixteen plants per treatment, harvest from four groups of four plants per plot twice weekly; transplant mid-May, harvest from mid-July, final stage 56 days first-to-last harvest. Table 1 prints the four F x M cell means plus main-factor marginal means.
system: commercial med-tech plastic greenhouse, soil beds with plastic mulch, fertigation

description: Exp 2 (section 2.3/3.2, Table 2, Fig S1-S2): Agricola Maresme Floriach greenhouse (2018), tomato cv. Otello grafted on Silex rootstock (two scions per rootstock, 2.22 stems m-2); 3 x 2 factorial irrigation (Etc 100% crop ET; Deficit 75% of Etc; Farm usual) x AMF (NM vs R. irregulare 40 g per plant at transplant); three replicates of two rows of eight plants; weekly harvest in eight plants per plot for three months from end of August. Total water supplied 620 (Etc), 510 (Deficit), 486 (Farm) L m-2. Table 2 prints ONLY main-factor marginal means; interaction stated non-significant; no 3 x 2 cell means in the original.
system: commercial med-tech plastic greenhouse, soil beds, drip irrigation

description: Exp 3 (section 2.4/3.3, Table 3, Figs 1-2): Agricola Maresme Rodon multi-tunnel greenhouse, cherry tomato cv. Riesling, transplant mid-February, weekly harvest from June in six plants per replicate; factorial irrigation (Sens: ET-based dose modulated by soil-moisture sensors, one independent valve per Sens cell; Farm: usual farm irrigation) x AMF (NM vs R. irregulare inoculum as in section 2.2). Replicate number not stated. Table 3 prints four cell means (yield kg m-2, water supply L m-2, water productivity kg m-3) without dispersion.
system: commercial multi-tunnel plastic greenhouse, soil, fertigation with sensor-driven or farm scheduling

description: Greenhouse pot experiment, TUC pilot greenhouse, Chania, Crete, Oct 2015-Apr 2016; tomato Elpida F1 in 35 L pots with calcareous clay loam soil from Timpaki; explicit 2x2 factorial of drip-irrigation salinity (NaCl ECw 1.1 'L' vs 3.5 dS m-1 'H', imposed after 10-day establishment) x Trichoderma harzianum T-22 (TRIANUM-P seedling drench once before planting, 'T') vs none ('N'); treatments LN (control), LT, HN, HT; n = 5 replicate plants/pots per treatment; 9 cumulative ripe-fruit harvests (Feb/Mar-Apr 2016). Fig. 6 fruit-number panels are boxplots with undefined statistic (no mean/SD/SE/CI); figure-statistic limitation only, design unchanged.
system: greenhouse pot (35 L), soil, drip fertigation; Solanum lycopersicum cv. Elpida F1

description: Single pot experiment, explicit 2x2 factorial: Bacillus methylotrophicus strain VL-10 substrate inoculation at sowing (none vs 5x10^8 CFU/g substrate) x temperature (normal 25/16 C [Table 1; Methods text 25/18 C] vs low temperature 15/8 C, 12 h/12 h, RH 60%, PPFD 300 umol m-2 s-1, for 14 d from 40 to 54 DAS in climate chambers); thereafter all plants grown in a glass greenhouse under normal management to fruiting. Tomato cv. Jinpeng No. 1 (cold sensitive). Arms CK, B, CK+LT, B+LT (Table 1). Organ fresh/dry weight at 40, 54, 61 DAS (Methods 2.2: 9 replicates per treatment, single plant = replicate; Fig. 2 caption: three independent biological replicates, SE; Methods 2.7: mean +/- SD); single fruit FW/DW of 1st-2nd inflorescence fruits (Fig. 7); fruit quality with two-way ANOVA PGPR, LT, PGPR x LT (Table 3). No fruit yield per plant or area reported.
system: Individual plastic pots (5x5x8 cm) with peat:vermiculite:perlite 2:1:1 substrate; 50-well plates to 30 DAS, climate chamber to 54 DAS, then glass greenhouse; seed source Xi'an Jinpeng Seed Co., China

description: Open-field tomato cv Vulcan F1, University of Naples Federico II experimental farm (Italy), sub-alkaline silty-clay-loam soil; 3 SWE (C, Rygex 2.50 mL/L, Super Fifty 2.00 mL/L, soil-applied via drip every 15 d from transplanting) x 2 salinity (0, 80 mM NaCl added to drip water from 37 DAS, weekly until end) full factorial; randomized block design with three replications, 80 m2 plots; transplant 32 DAS at 3.3 plants/m2; single destructive harvest 115 DAS. Tables 1-4 report only factor marginal means (mapped to E1.MARG.* non-factorial pseudo-arms, each isolated in its own background); Figures 1-5 show the six factorial cell means. Fruit yield (Table 4 FruitsFW) exists only as marginal means. Marginal-row n (6 plots per B row, 9 plots per S row) is design-derived from 3 blocks x 3x2 factorial, not printed per row.
system: open field, drip irrigation, randomized block plots

description: Open-field grafted tomato trial, Season 1 (labelled 2020 season in tables). 9 treatment combinations = 3 rootstocks (self-grafted Peto 86, S. cheesmaniae LA 524, GS hybrid; scion Peto 86) x 3 rootstock seed treatments (untreated, shikimic acid 60 ppm priming, S. griseus 1x10^7 CFU/mL soak) under ambient winter low temperature; RCBD with three replicates (Methods 4.3 p.17). No SA+SG combined arm, no non-stressed control. Methods dates: sown 1-3 Dec 2020, grafted 25-27 Dec 2020, transplanted 7 Jan 2021 (Results text p4 calls this the '2021' season - reporting inconsistency only).
system: Open field, Giza, Egypt; tongue-grafted transplants 35 cm apart on ridges 1.5 m wide x 14 m long; clay loam

description: Open-field grafted tomato trial, Season 2 (labelled 2021 season in tables). Same 9 treatment combinations = 3 rootstocks (self-grafted Peto 86, S. cheesmaniae LA 524, GS hybrid; scion Peto 86) x 3 rootstock seed treatments (untreated, shikimic acid 60 ppm priming, S. griseus 1x10^7 CFU/mL soak) under ambient winter low temperature; RCBD with three replicates (Methods 4.3 p.17). No SA+SG combined arm, no non-stressed control. Methods dates: sown 1-3 Dec 2021, grafted 25-27 Dec 2021, transplanted 10 Jan 2022 (Results text p4 calls this the '2022' season - reporting inconsistency only).
system: Open field, Giza, Egypt; tongue-grafted transplants 35 cm apart on ridges 1.5 m wide x 14 m long; clay loam

description: Greenhouse pot experiment, Solanum lycopersicum cv. Rio Fuego, CUCBA University of Guadalajara, Mexico, Feb-Jun 2021. Complete 2x2 of NaCl salinity (none vs. 100 mL saline drench ramped 150/200/250/300 mM from 35 DAG, then 300 mM through phase two) x Padina gymnospora seaweed extract (none vs. 0.2% w/v, 100 mL soil drench at 15 DAG and every 5 d to 45 DAG = 7 applications, then every 8 d in phase two). Phase one ran 15-46 DAG (vegetative; destructive growth, physiology and biochemistry at 46 DAG, fresh weights only). Phase two ran 47-85 DAG in 8-L pots, with flowers, fruit number and fruit fresh weight per plant from a single harvest at the end of phase two (86 DAG per Sec 2.8; 85 DAG per Sec 2.3/3.4/Fig 1). 60 plants were randomly divided into 4 groups of 15 (Sec 2.4). Statistics were one-way ANOVA with LSD, reported as means +/- SD of three independent replicates (Sec 2.9). Re-verified in rev-2 against original PDF pp3-8 and p13 (receipts in notes); the methods inconsistency about plant identity across phases (Sec 2.6 vs Sec 2.4) and the effective n (3 replicates vs 15 plants) are flagged for extraction QA.
system: greenhouse pot (3-L pots in phase one, 8-L pots in phase two); substrate vermiculite:peat moss:organic soil 2:2:2 v/v/v

description: Greenhouse pot experiment, tomato cv. Rio Grande, UNPRG Lambayeque Peru, Nov 2019-Mar 2020: two CRD trials (non-saline soil EC 1.40 dS/m vs saline soil EC 10.28 dS/m), uninoculated control vs three ACC-deaminase Actinobacteria (Streptomyces sp. strains 21 and 10, Nocardia sp. strain 13) applied as seed inoculation (0.5 mL, 1e8 conidia/mL, 9 h) plus root immersion (300 mL inoculum) at transplant 40 DAS; fruit harvest and biomass at 120 DAT (Tables 1-2). Chemical-fertilizer comparator arms of the same trials are mapped separately in E2.
system: greenhouse pot (clay pots, 3 kg soil, 2 plants per pot)

description: Bookkeeping partition of core experiment 632_EXP01 (same two CRD trials as E1): chemical NPK fertilizer comparator arms (urea 46% N, diammonium phosphate 46% P, potassium sulfate 50% K; amount not reported) without Actinobacteria, in non-saline and saline soil. Not an independent experiment; separated only because the fertilization background differs from E1. Not a biostimulant arm.
system: greenhouse pot (clay pots, 3 kg soil, 2 plants per pot)

description: Growth-chamber pot experiment, tomato cv. Ailsa Craig, crossed 2x2 Trichoderma brevicompactum SZMC 22661 (suspension 1.75x10^6 CFU/mL added 7 d after transplantation) x drought (watering withheld from 3 d after Trichoderma for 7 d, SWC ~10%; control watered to 75% soil mixture water capacity); 10 plants per treatment; sampling and dry biomass 7 d after drought start (PDF p2 Sect. 2.1-2.2, receipt SRC-f7a0c2996f4596cc8c09f20c; Table 2 p4, receipt SRC-bfeb971cdb2c0a7e299c8fc4).
system: growth chamber, pots (soil:compost:sand 1:1:1, 24 cm depth)

description: Semi-controlled shadehouse pot trial (FST/UCAD, Dakar, Senegal; Dec 2020-Feb 2021): 2 tomato hybrid varieties (Lady Nema, Mongal) x 4 inoculum levels (un-inoculated control; Claroideoglomus etunicatum BEG 176; Rhizophagus fasciculatus DAOM 227130; Funneliformis mosseae DAOM 227131; 20 g inoculum per bag at sowing) x 4 NaCl levels (0, 70, 140, 210 mM, irrigation applied after 2 weeks of field-capacity watering); 15 plants per cell (480 plants), one plant per 2 kg sterilized Sangalkam soil bag; single destructive harvest at 3 months; three-way ANOVA + SNK.
system: pot, semi-controlled shadehouse, sterilized sandy Sangalkam soil 2 kg per polyethylene bag

description: Main growth-chamber pot experiment at IGZ (Germany): tomato cv. Moneymaker, 1-week-old seedlings transplanted into autoclaved sand:vermiculite 1:1 containing DSE inoculum or mock inoculum; full 5 inoculation x 3 NaCl (0/60/115 mM; EC 2.5/5.5/10.5 dS/m in Hoagland solution) factorial; 7 replicate pots per treatment; single destructive harvest 6 weeks after transplanting/inoculation, before flowering (shoot/root FW and DW, colonization, shoot P/N/C/Na/K, P/N uptake).
system: growth chamber pot experiment

description: Greenhouse polybag experiment, tomato S-22: 2 soil salinity levels (0 and 4 dS/m, NaCl-amended autoclaved vertisol) x 6 inoculation treatments (non-inoculated; Bacillus pumilus NCT4, B. firmus NCT1, B. licheniformis LCT4, B. cereus LAT3, B. safensis LBM4 as 30-min seed biopriming + 30 mL active culture per bag at sowing); 10 bags x 2 plants per treatment; stopped after two months; repeated three times.
system: uncontrolled greenhouse; polythene bags with 3 kg soil

description: Single shelter (semi-controlled) pot experiment, FST/UCAD Plant Biology Department, Senegal: full factorial 2 tomato hybrids (Lady Nema, Xewel) x 4 inoculum levels (un-inoculated control; Claroideoglomus etunicatum BEG 176; Rhizophagus fasciculatus DAOM 227130; Funneliformis mosseae DAOM 227131; 20 g maize-root/spore/hyphae inoculum per bag placed around the seeds at 1-3 cm at sowing) x 3 water regimes (T100 = watered at field capacity; T70 = 70% FC; T30 = 30% FC; imposed after 2 weeks at FC). One plant per 2 kg black polyethylene bag of autoclaved Sangalkam sandy soil; 10 plants per cell, 240 plants; destructive harvest after 3 months. Layout per Figure 1: one block per inoculum level (unreplicated), varieties and water regimes in rows within each block.
system: semi-controlled shelter (shade-house), pots/bags 2 kg autoclaved Sangalkam soil

description: Sub-optimal nutrient regimen stratum (Sub = 50% standard nutrient solution without NH4NO3) of the single greenhouse pot experiment (Micro Tom tomato, 10 cm pots of 100% peat, drip fertigation twice daily from 35 DAS, Naples, sown May 2015). Complete 2 x 3 crossing within stratum: mock (5% sucrose) vs Azotobacter chroococcum 76A root-zone inoculum (~1e7 CFU/g quartz sand, at 30 DAS transplant and 71 DAS) x NaCl 0/50/100 mM added to the nutrient solution. Terminal destructive harvest 90 DAS. Part of the 2 inoculum x 6 nutrient-solution two-way ANOVA design (paper p2-p3).
system: greenhouse; 10 cm pots, 100% peat moss; drip fertigation from independent 100 L tank per nutrient solution

description: Optimal nutrient regimen stratum (Opt = 100% standard nutrient solution augmented with 3.25 mM NH4NO3) of the same single greenhouse pot experiment as E1 (same cohort, site, season, substrate, inoculation protocol, harvest). Complete 2 x 3 crossing within stratum: mock (5% sucrose) vs A. chroococcum 76A (~1e7 CFU/g quartz sand, 30 and 71 DAS) x NaCl 0/50/100 mM. Terminal destructive harvest 90 DAS.
system: greenhouse; 10 cm pots, 100% peat moss; drip fertigation from independent 100 L tank per nutrient solution

description: PUBLISHED MARGINAL MEANS of experiment 373_EXP01 (Tables 2-4): inoculum rows Control/76 A pooled over all six nutrient solutions, and nutrient-solution rows (Sub/Opt x 0/50/100 mM NaCl) pooled over inoculum. Not independent treatment arms and not factorial cells; computed from the same plants as E1/E2 cells; retained only so marginal values (incl. fruit fresh weight, available only here) can be recorded. No contrasts may be formed.
system: aggregation of the E1/E2 greenhouse experiment

description: Plate culture experiment: 4-day-old germinated tomato (HYBRID Seven F.1) seedlings transferred to vertical MS agar plates (10 seedlings/plate) containing 0, 50 or 100 mM NaCl, with or without a 6 mm active T. viride RA1 agar disc inoculated at the opposite end of the plate (Table 1 T0-T5); 25 C, 16/8 h photoperiod; seedlings harvested 10 days after NaCl (height, FW, DW Fig. 5; water status Table 4; biochemistry/enzymes Figs 6-7). 5 replicates/treatment; experiment run twice.
system: laboratory vertical MS agar plates

description: Greenhouse pot experiment (Zagazig University, 30-35 C, 60-85% RH): 30-day-old tomato seedlings (HYBRID Seven F.1), 2 per pot in 2 kg sterile clay soil; T. viride RA1 arms received 4 h root soak in fungal suspension plus 100 mL fungal inoculum soil drench at transplant (non-inoculated arms: equivalent tap water); NaCl 0/50/100 mM solutions added 1 week after transplant; salinity x T. viride entirely randomized across pots; sampled 20 days after salt (Table 5 morphology, shoot/root FW and DW). 5 replicates/treatment; experiment run twice.
system: greenhouse plastic pots, sterile clay soil

description: Greenhouse pot experiment, tomato var. Heinz-1370 seedlings in perlite (100 mL pots, one plant per pot), NaCl 0/25/50/100 mM crossed with vermicompost leachate (WizzardWorms VCL 1:10 v/v in 50% Hoagland) or none; 8 cells, four replicates of five pots each; harvest at 10 weeks of plant age.
system: greenhouse perlite pots (100 mL), 50% Hoagland nutrient solution, 22/15 C day/night, 60+/-5% RH, PPFD 450 umol m-2 s-1

description: Bioprospection screen (Figure 2 dry weight, Table 3 RGR/WUEp): tomato var. Robin seedlings at two-true-leaf stage (two weeks) in 150-cell trays; mock well-watered (100% FC) and mock water deficit (50% FC, half-strength Hoagland) controls, plus 9 laboratory aqueous seaweed extracts (1% w/v) and 2 purchased commercial seaweed products (Kelpak, Sealgae; concentration not reported), all applied under WD as 5 mL to the root system at day 0. 7-day water-deficit period; N=20 plants per treatment; results are the mean of three independent experiments; one-way ANOVA, Duncan post hoc. WW/WD controls shown as dashed reference lines in Figure 2. No extract x WW arms, so not factorial.
system: growth chamber 24+/-2 C, 16/8 h photoperiod, 65+/-2% RH, 300 umol m-2 s-1; 150-cell seedling trays, universal substrate; half-strength Hoagland as water supply

description: Galaxaura rugosa x water regime experiment (Figure 1 schema; Figure 3A dry weight; Table 4 RGR/WUEp/SSI/STI; Figures 4-5 gas exchange days 1/3/5): explicit complete 2x2 factorial WW (100% FC) / WD (50% FC) x mock / G. rugosa aqueous extract 1% w/v, 5 mL to the root system at day 0. Arms WW, WD, A-WW, A-WD; tomato var. Robin seedlings; 7 days; N=20 plants per treatment; mean of three independent experiments. Figure 1 day-0 volumes: WW 10 mL nutritive solution, WD 5 mL nutritive solution, A-WW 5 mL extract + 5 mL nutritive solution, A-WD 5 mL extract; daily 10 mL (WW) or 5 mL (WD) nutritive solution. Separate run from E1 (different control levels).
system: growth chamber 24+/-2 C, 16/8 h photoperiod, 65+/-2% RH, 300 umol m-2 s-1; 150-cell seedling trays, universal substrate; half-strength Hoagland (10 mL/day WW, 5 mL/day WD)

description: Seasonal reproducibility test (Figure 3B; caption panel letters appear transposed in the original): G. rugosa extracts 1, 2 and 3 made from algae collected in different seasons (Methods 2.1: collections between 2021 and 2022; seasons not named per extract), each applied under water deficit (50% FC) to tomato var. Robin seedlings for 7 days per general Methods 2.4. WW and WD dry-weight averages shown as dashed reference lines without error bars; these differ from Figure 3A controls, so a separate run. No extract x WW arms; not factorial.
system: growth chamber 24+/-2 C, 16/8 h photoperiod, 65+/-2% RH, 300 umol m-2 s-1; 150-cell seedling trays, universal substrate; half-strength Hoagland

description: Mechanistic qRT-PCR (Methods 2.8, Figure 6B): ten-day-old tomato cv. Moneymaker seedlings treated with mock (containing residual ABA equal to that in the extract, 0.45+/-0.12 nM) or 0.5% G. rugosa extract for 6 h, no imposed stress. Expression of SlRAB18 and SlLEA normalized to SlEF1a. Replication not described. No biomass or yield endpoint; retained for core identity stability only.
system: seedling treatment / qRT-PCR

description: Pot experiment (open field, rain shelter when needed), tomato cv. BARI Tomato 2, one plant per pot in 8 kg sandy loam:decomposed cow dung (3:1). CRD, nine treatments x four pots: T1 buffer-only stressed control and T2-T9 single PGPR strains (2 h seedling root dip ca. 1e8 CFU/mL at transplant + 50 mL 1e8 CFU/mL drench at 46 DPP). Irrigation withheld 46-58 DPP in all arms; uprooted at 58 DPP. Conducted once; no well-watered treatment.
system: pot, open field with rain shelter when required

description: Greenhouse pot experiment (Institute of Agricultural Sciences, University of the Punjab, Lahore): tomato in 60 cm plastic pots with sterilized silt loam soil, natural light, thinned to 3 plants/pot 15 d after emergence; salinity 0, 100, 200 mM NaCl solution added to growing media (irrigated to field capacity) x 9 bacterial groups (uninoculated control + halotolerant strains A05, A06, A09, A11, A12 [B. megaterium], A16, A17, A20 [P. putida]) as 100 mL aqueous cell suspension per pot; growth assessed 30 days post inoculation (Table 2, mean of three independent replicates, DNMRT letters only). Complete 3 x 9 crossing reported cell by cell in one experiment on common greenhouse background; pot randomization not described.
system: greenhouse pots, sterilized silt loam soil

description: Field experiments in two consecutive years (2012, 2013), Lahore: saline treatments in salt-affected field patch (EC 5.13 dS/m, University of the Punjab agricultural fields) and non-saline treatments at the experimental station of the Institute of Agricultural Sciences (separate site acting as non-saline control). T1 non-treated control, T2 salinity alone, T3 B. megaterium A12 + salinity, T4 P. putida A20 + salinity, T5 A12 alone, T6 A20 alone; sugarcane pressmud-based formulations 0.5 kg/plot at transplanting of 15-d-old seedlings; RCBD with three replication plots (2x2 m, 10 seedlings/plot), no fertilization; shoot length 60 DAT (Table 3), fruits/plant and fruit weight/5 fruits 90 DAT (Table 4), mean +/- SE. Salinity confounded with site, so not a factorial on a common background.
system: open field plots at two sites (saline patch and non-saline station)

description: Independent greenhouse experiment 'as described in above section' using only B. megaterium A12: 2x2 Non-treated control, NaCl, A12, NaCl + A12 (Table 5 water use efficacy based on dry and on fresh biomass, mg biomass per mg H2O, mean +/- SE; Figs 4-5 enzymes/ethylene not mapped). NaCl concentration, n and assessment time not stated.
system: greenhouse pots (protocol as E1)

description: Main 2x2 factorial in hydroponics: Se (0 vs 0.025 mM Na2SeO3 in nutrient solution) x PEG-6000 drought (0 vs 10% w/v per Methods), four arms CK/Se/PEG/PEG+Se, tomato Ailsa Craig seedlings, 15 d; Table 1 dry weights (shoot, root, total), Fig 1-4 physiology.
system: hydroponic 1/4 modified Hoagland nutrient solution (pH 6.2, renewed every 3 d), seedlings pre-grown in greenhouse

description: ABT inhibitor experiment: PEG, PEG+Se, PEG+Se+ABT (100 uM 1-aminobenzotriazole pre-spray, salicylic acid biosynthesis inhibitor), four-leaf tomato plants; Fig 5 physiology/phenotype only, no biomass target, no non-stress control, no ABT-only arm (not factorial).
system: hydroponic 1/4 modified Hoagland nutrient solution (pH 6.2, renewed every 3 d)

description: Tomato cv. Chibli F1 seedlings, aerated hydroponic nutrient solution in a growth chamber (26/20 C, 16 h, 150 umol m-2 s-1): 8 d pre-growth then 8 d treatment with 0 or 120 mM NaCl, with or without 100 or 300 uM sodium nitroprusside (NO donor); no SNP-only arm.
system: growth_chamber_hydroponic

description: Experiment 1 (water-deficit method validation): tomato seedlings at two-true-leaf stage in commercial 150-cell peat trays, growth chamber (20-27 C, 16/8 h, 300 umol m-2 s-1), all watered with half-strength Hoagland; well-watered (100% of daily cell field capacity) vs water deficit (50%) for 7 days; no biostimulant. Whole-seedling DW day 7 in Fig 3A (p6). 20 seedlings per treatment, triplicate experiments.
system: growth chamber, 150-cell seedling trays (peat)

description: Experiment 2 (biostimulant screening): same seedling/tray/chamber system; WW 100% FC and WD 50% FC controls receiving the same volume of half-strength Hoagland, plus 12 treatments under WD (Pr 1 mM, Put 1 mM, Spd 0.1 mM, Nspd 1 mM, Spm 1 mM, Nspm 0.1 mM, Pyg 1 mM, Mel 1 mM, Na-Si 1 mM, K-Si 2 mM, GB 0.1 mM, Kelpak 5%) applied as 5 mL solution per seedling in half-strength Hoagland pH 6 (Table 1 p5; p9). Whole-seedling DW after 7 days in Fig 7A (p10). Minimum 20 plants per treatment, triplicate experiments. Single concentration per compound; not factorial; no biostimulant-under-WW arm.
system: growth chamber, 150-cell seedling trays (peat)

description: BABA application-volume test (Table 3, p11): WW (5 mL Hoagland) and WD (5 mL Hoagland) controls plus BABA 1 mM under WD 50% FC at 1, 3 and 5 mL per seedling; seedling DW (mg) after 7 days; plants/treatment 60 = plants used in triplicate experiments (footnote, printed for BABA rows only). Control values differ from Fig 3A/Fig 7A, so this is a separate run with its own controls. Not factorial.
system: growth chamber, 150-cell seedling trays (peat)

description: Greenhouse well-watered screen (section 2.4, Table 1): tomato cv. Pusa Rajdhani seeds bacterized with each of 10 ACC deaminase producing PGPR isolates (Rhizo SF 4, 7, 9, 23, 41, 44, 48, 64, 90, 108) or untreated control (SDW + CMC), sown in 80 mm poly cups with 10 g sterilized soil:sand:FYM 2:1:1, thinned to one plant at 10 DAS, grown well-watered in RCBD and harvested at 35 DAS; shoot dry weight SDW (g) mean +/- SE, n = 4 independent replicates (four replicates of 25 plants each per 2.9). No imposed stress.
system: greenhouse pot (poly cup) experiment, sterilized potting medium, RCBD

description: Greenhouse drought experiment (sections 2.6.1-2.6.2, Fig. 3): tomato cv. Pusa Rajdhani plants from seeds bacterized with B. subtilis Rhizo SF 48 or untreated control (SDW + CMC), raised as in 2.4; at 21 DAS uniformly grown treated and untreated plants were divided into five watering groups WW (watering on alternate days), S1 (no watering for 2 days), S2 (3 days), S3 (4 days), S4 (5 days), at least three drought cycles, harvested at end of 40 DAS. Full 2 (control vs Rhizo SF 48) x 5 (WW, S1-S4) crossed design with all 10 cells reported in Fig. 3C shoot dry weight (g plant-1), SE bars, n = 4.
system: greenhouse pot (poly cup) experiment, sterilized potting medium, cyclic water withholding

description: Pot sand-ponic experiment (washed sand + nutrient solution, 2 seedlings/pot, transplanted first week of December) at the wire house of the National Research Centre, Dokki, Giza, Egypt, conducted in two successive winter seasons 2017-2018 and 2018-2019 under ambient low temperature (night temperature several times below 10 C). Two tomato cultivars (Strain B, Florida) x three treatments (Control; ASA 1 mM; ASA 2 mM applied exogenously, foliar per abstract, at 15 and 30 days after transplanting). Complete randomized design, 15 replicates per treatment (unit unstated). Growth sampled at 75 DAT; fruits harvested weekly, total yield g/plant. Printed tables show a single unlabelled value set; season identity and any pooling across the two seasons are not stated.
system: pot sand-ponic culture, wire house (abstract: green house), winter ambient low temperature

description: Growth chamber (Phytotron) pot trial, Solanum lycopersicum L. JANA F1, one plant per pot in peat moss, MAScIR Morocco. Complete 4x4 crossed factorial: NaCl 0, 80, 120, 150 mM x MEF microalgae-cyanobacteria extract formulation untreated, 1%, 5%, 10% v/v by soil drench (10 mL per pot every week). 16 treatments in Fig. 1a-d; biochemical analyses only untreated and MEF5%. Harvest at 40 days old. Two-way ANOVA, Tukey. Five replications sampled per treatment, three most homogenous for biochemistry.
system: growth chamber (Phytotron), pots/seed trays, peat moss

description: Greenhouse pot experiment, Faculty of Science Semlalia, Cadi Ayyad University, Marrakesh, Morocco; tomato cv. Campbell 33 seedlings (two-leaf stage) in 5 kg sterilized soil pots for 4 months; RCBD with fully crossed water regime (75% vs 35% FC) x AMF (-/+ native consortium 20 g inoculum) x amendment (Control, NPK 7 g/pot, composts C1-C5 at 5%); 28 cells, 5 replicates each (PDF p4 Table 2).
system: greenhouse pot

description: 2018 pot (plastic tube) experiment, Horticulture Nursery, Dept. of Horticulture, The University of Agriculture Peshawar, Pakistan; tomato cv. Rio Grande; two-factor CRD: water stress irrigation interval (3 d = 100% FC reference, 6 d = 70% WC, 9 d = 50% WC, 12 d = 30% WC) x foliar chitosan (0 control, 50, 100, 150 mg/L), 16 combinations, each repeated three times; stress and sprays from 15 days after transplanting; glass/lathe house.
system: pot/plastic tubes in glass house (abstract) / lathe house (Methods)

description: Greenhouse pot trial, tomato cv. Doucen in 18-cm pots with peat moss; foliar Trichoderma culture filtrate (100%, 30 ml/plant) 12 days after transplanting, A. solani spore suspension (10^4 spores/ml, 30 ml/plant) sprayed 24 h later; healthy control water-sprayed, infected control pathogen only; 6 replicates x 6 plants per treatment, experiment repeated twice (2020). Outcomes: disease severity (Fig. 3), shoot/root fresh and dry weight after disease assessment (Table 2; duplicated in Supplementary Table S1). No filtrate-only arm: not factorial.
system: greenhouse pots

description: Open-field trial Season I (early season, January-March 2020), Hada Al Sham field station of King Abdulaziz University, tomato cv. Doucen transplanted at 3-4 leaf stage (60 cm between rows, 45 cm within row); foliar culture filtrate 100%, 50 ml/plant, one week after transplanting; natural early blight infection; CK naturally infected untreated. Design per 2.7: completely randomized block design, six replicates x nine plants (2.8 says quadruplicate - unresolved). Outcomes: disease severity (Fig. 6A) and season-total fruit yield kg/treatment (Fig. 6B, text 3.6.2).
system: open field

description: Open-field trial Season II (late season, September-December 2020), same site, cultivar, treatments and design as Season I ('an experiment with identical parameters was performed in the late season'); natural early blight infection; CK naturally infected untreated. Outcomes: disease severity (Fig. 6A) and season-total fruit yield kg/treatment (Fig. 6B, text 3.6.2). Replication 6 x 9 plants (2.7) vs quadruplicate (2.8) unresolved.
system: open field

description: Seedling growth pot assay (Methods 2.9, Table 3): tomato cv. description: Field trial one, Qixia district, Nanjing, Jiangsu, 1999, open field (Methods 2.4 physical p2; Table 2 physical p4): cv 'Zao Feng'; 10 replications per treatment; plots 5 m x 2 m with 60 seedlings; strain suspension diluted 100x with water, mixed into organic fertilizer and applied into soil, field raked and covered with plastic film, transplanting 7 days later; natural bacterial wilt infestation. Zhongza No. 9 imbibed 1 h in washed bacterial suspension (OD600 = 1.0) of one strain (TF1-TF7) or sterile distilled water (control), placed in 8.5 cm Petri dishes on two filter papers soaked in NaCl 0, 25 or 50 mM; 3 d dark 25 C then 5 d 12/12 h light 25 C; 4 replicate dishes x 25 seeds per treatment, randomized complete block design; germination, shoot length, root length, vigour index on day 8. 3 NaCl x 8 inoculation arms = 24 cells, two-way ANOVA SC x BS. description: Growth-chamber pot experiment (Fig. 2, physical p31; Methods p11-12): tomato cv. Zhongza No. 9 sown in sterilized pots of wet vermiculite (one plant per pot), 12:12 h, about 150 umol m-2 s-1, 25/18 C, 40 days; in week 2 uniform seedlings fertilized once with 1/2 Hoagland; 3 d later seedlings drenched once with 40 ml bacterial suspension (OD600 = 1.0) of one strain (TF1-TF7) or deionized water (control); then each seedling irrigated with 4 ml NaCl 0, 150 or 300 mM daily for the rest of the experiment. Block design with 4 replicates per treatment x 4 seedlings per replicate; harvested day 40; root length, root diameter classes, shoot length, stem diameter, fresh weight and dry weight (g plant-1; shoot and root dried at 70 C). 3 NaCl x 8 arms = 24 cells, two-way ANOVA SC x BS, Tukey HSD, bars = SE. Target slot: Fig. 2B Dry weight (24 values).

description: Preliminary greenhouse pot experiment (Methods 2.4.2, p3): factorial arrangement of 10 treatments, 2 salt levels (distilled water vs 150 mM NaCl irrigation) x 5 bacteria levels (mock Control, Cellulosimicrobium 60I1, Ochrobactrum 53F, Enterobacter 64S1, Pseudomonas 42P4), 10 replicates (n = 10; Fig. 2 caption: individual plants), 0.75 L plastic pots (plants per pot not stated). Two-way ANOVA with interaction (Fig. 2B: P(b)<0.0001, P(s)<0.0001, P(bxs)=0.4579).

description: Repeated greenhouse pot experiment (Methods 2.4.2, p3: 'performed again under the same conditions previously described with the two most promising strains'): factorial arrangement of 6 treatments, 2 salt levels (distilled water vs 150 mM NaCl) x 3 bacteria levels (mock Control, Enterobacter 64S1, Pseudomonas 42P4); Methods: 20 replicates (n = 20); captions report n = 10 (Fig. 3, Fig. 6, Table 3), n = 4 (Fig. 5), n = 5 (Figs. 7, 8). system: greenhouse pots, Kekkila DSM 1 W peat medium + sand 1:1, 0.75 L

system: growth chamber; vermiculite, one seedling per 7 cm plastic pot; 25/20 C day/night; 12 h light (25 or 75 umol photons m-2 s-1, unspecified)

description: Seedling flask assay in growth chamber, tomato cv. Farmers 301, 30 surface-sterilized seeds per 50 mL flask on filter paper; 1 mL inoculum 1e8 CFU/mL at 10 days after seeding (control: sterilized broth); 1 mL 0.75% NaCl added 3 days after inoculation to solution EC 6 dS/m; flasks closed 24 h, headspace ethylene by GC (eight flask replicates), then proline in four seedlings; arms Control, CHB 1107 WT, CHB 1107 M, CHB 1107 M/pBM2-RBSacdS1107 (p4, Fig 2, Fig 3). system: growth chamber flask, filter paper seedlings

description: Pot experiment, tomato BARI Tomato 2, CRD: 8 inoculation treatments (uninoculated control; L. adecarboxylata ESK12; E. ludwigii ESK17; G. arilaitensis ESM4; E. cloacae ESM12; B. subtilis ESM14; P. putida ESM17; E. acetylicum ESM24; root bacterization ca. 1e8 CFU/mL at transplanting of 16-day-old seedlings and 7 d later) x 2 irrigation regimes (sterile tap water non-stress vs sterile seawater 10 dS/m from 24-day-old plants); one seedling per 2 kg pot of sterile vermicompost:garden soil 3:1 under poly shade; 4 replications per Methods, n=3 per figure captions; experiment repeated two times; harvest of 40-day-old plants for shoot and root dry weight (p16-p18, Fig.7 p11).

description: Pot study on tomato during the monsoon season, 500 g unsterile soil in 10 cm pots, NaCl externally added to final 2%, four germinated seeds per pot, 30 ml active culture of one of five NaCl-adapted PGPR isolates per pot, watered 10 ml DW daily, triplicate pots, all plants uprooted 45 days after sowing; arms C-ve, C+ve, NT1, T15, T5, C4, C5 (p3 Methods, p6 Fig 4/5 and Table 2).
system: pot study (facility not stated)

description: Experiment V: yield and its attributes. Tomato cv. Ailsa Craig in pots (CRD). Foliar 1 uM 24-epibrassinolide vs 0.01% ethanol control (both with 0.1% Teepol), sprayed at 30 days old (12.5 ml/plant) and 60 days old (25 ml/plant). After the second spray, one set (5+5 plants) was moved to a 35/27 C heat-stress greenhouse; the other set stayed in the 25/20 C normal greenhouse. Twice-weekly harvests were pooled to the final harvest (~4-month-old plants). Outcomes: fruit weight per plant (g) and fruit number per plant (Fig. 4, p7; mean +/- SEM, n=5). description: Season 2020, Pole Legumes, Lorgies, France (plastic tunnel 105 m2, colluvial brunisol 90 cm). Tomato cv. Paola planted 4 May 2020 (DOY 125). Randomized block design, 4 blocks x 6 treatments = 24 plots of 14 plants. Treatments: well-watered control (1 L/plant/day, two drippers), stressed control (0.6 L/plant/day, 40% less), and stressed + ASCO-N2, SOLI-C, ECKL-M, ASCO-N1. Ripe fruit harvested weekly per plot DOY 197-259 (16 Jul-15 Sep 2020). Yield outcome Fig.7a: y-axis fruit weight per plot (kg), caption says per plant (conflict logged), n=4, SE.
system: soil-grown tomato in plastic tunnel (field plots), drip irrigation

description: Season 2021, same tunnel and site as E1. Tomato cv. Paola planted 18 May 2021 (DOY 138). Randomized block design, 4 blocks x 6 treatments = 24 plots of 14 plants. Treatments: well-watered control (1.2 L/plant/day, two drippers), stressed control (0.4 L/plant/day, 67% less), and stressed + ASCO-N2, SOLI-C, ECKL-M, NSF (S. latissima, replacing ASCO-N1). Ripe fruit harvested weekly per plot DOY 214-279 (2 Aug-6 Oct 2021). Yield outcome Fig.7b: y-axis fruit weight per plot (kg), caption says per plant (conflict logged), n=4, SE.
system: soil-grown tomato in plastic tunnel (field plots), drip irrigation

description: Tomato (Lycopersicon esculentum var. Mill, cultivar not stated) seedling pot experiment: seeds germinated 5 d on wet filter paper, transferred to 7x7x7 cm plastic pots with horticultural soil mix (cocopeat 60%, peat moss 20%, vermiculite 10%, perlite 7%, seaweed mix 3%), 15 h light/9 h dark at 22 C under fluorescent light. 2x2 factorial: Enterobacter sp. EJ01 soil inoculation (Con vs EJ01, two days after transfer) x irrigation with distilled water with or without 200 mM NaCl every three days. Harvest after one month: aerial parts length, fresh weight, dry weight (2 d at 75 C). n = 16 per group (Fig. 1 caption).

description: No-GA4 background of the single greenhouse pot CRD (core EXP01): tomato (Solanum lycopersicum, cultivar not reported) seedlings, sterilized horticulture soil, 30 +/- 2 C. Arms Control, LK11, NaCl, LK11+NaCl. LK11 10^8 CFU/mL: 50 mL seed priming at sowing + 50 mL to 14-d seedlings; NaCl 50 mL 250 mM daily for 7 d from 3 weeks old; nutrient broth mock for controls. Single seedling harvest upon completion of stress; Table 1 (p6) mean +/- SD. Replication as printed: 'three replications (21 plants per replica)' and 'All the experiments were repeated three times'; n per arm unresolved. Co-randomized with E2 arms (one dependency cluster).
system: controlled greenhouse, pots

description: GA4 background (GA4 50 mL of 100 uM to 14-d seedlings, plant growth regulator, not a biostimulant) of the SAME greenhouse pot CRD as E1 (subset of core EXP01, not an independent experiment): arms GA4, NaCl+GA4, LK11+NaCl+GA4. Same LK11, NaCl, substrate, timing, harvest, Table 1 (p6) mean +/- SD and replication statement as E1. Fig. 3 (p7, antioxidant enzymes, not a target) labels a 'LK11-GA4' bar and has no NaCl+GA4 bar; the source does not resolve this label discrepancy and no arm is mapped from it.

description: Greenhouse pot experiment, UWI St. Augustine, Trinidad. Tomato Hybrid-61 in 1 L pots (2:1 sharp sand:Promix), 7-day acclimatization at 100% FC. Completely randomized, fully factorial 2 spray (water control vs A. nodosum extract 0.5% v/v foliar, once, 6 h before drought) x 3 moisture (100% FC 150 ml/d, 50% FC 75 ml/d, 25% FC 37.5 ml/d) = 6 arms, two-way ANOVA. Shoot and root DW (Fig 4) taken once after two weeks of water deficit (20 days after transplanting). n for biomass not printed.
system: greenhouse

description: Open-field trial, farmer's field, Valencia, Trinidad, fine-loamy soil, dry season Feb-May 2021. Hybrid-61 transplanted at 6 weeks, 100 x 50 cm, staked. Randomized block design, 3 replicates x 50 plants per replicate plot. 4 crossed treatments: SWE or Control x 100% Irrigation (regular) or 25% Irrigation (75% reduction), deficit from 6 weeks after transplanting until harvest complete. SWE 0.5% v/v foliar every 10 days. One-way ANOVA. Total fruit yield summed over successive harvests (Fig 6b, means +/- SE of 3 plots, denominator not printed), plant height at end, RWC after 4 days of deficit.
system: open_field

description: Mechanistic time-course on healthy, unstressed 6-week-old Hybrid-61 seedlings sprayed once on leaves with 0.5% v/v A. nodosum extract or water. Triplicate leaf samples at 0, 12, 24, 48, 72, 96 h from duplicated trials. qPCR marker genes (Fig 7), antioxidant enzymes and osmolytes (Fig 8), repeated-measures ANOVA. No fruit yield or dry biomass endpoint.
system: controlled_environment_unspecified

description: Exp1 (Methods 4.4 p15-16; Results 2.2; Fig.1 a-d p4): growth promotion WITHOUT salt stress. 1-month-old Raf tomato seedlings in pots (50% v/v plant substrate + 50% v/v vermiculite), watered regularly; 4 arms: non-inoculated control (3 mL M9 buffer) vs D. barathri MT2.1T, D. profundi MT2.2T, D. nishinomiyaensis DSM20448T (3 mL of 10^8-10^9 CFU/mL in 0.5X M9 buffer per seedling, single application). description: Exp2 (Methods 4.5 p16; Results 2.3; Fig.2 a-f p5, Fig.3): growth under 150 mM NaCl. 1-month-old Raf tomato seedlings in trays 2.5x2.5x7 cm, watered 7 d, growth room; 150 mM NaCl solution added = day 0 (EC1:5 0.329 -> 1.158 dS m-1). 5 arms: -NaCl non-inoculated (C); +150 mM NaCl non-inoculated with 0.5X M9 buffer (S); +150 mM NaCl + DSM20448T / MT2.1T / MT2.2T, 2 mL/seedling of 10^8-10^9 CFU/mL poured (SB). description: Greenhouse plastic pot-tray (96 cavities, sterilized coco peat) seedling growth experiment without pathogen (Sec 2.6, 2.7, Tables 2, 4, 5): untreated sterile-water control vs B. subtilis OTPB1 cell suspension vs T. harzianum OTPB3 spore suspension applied 1 ml/cavity at seeding; tomato cv. Arka Vikas grown 30 days at 25 +/- 2 C under natural light; 3 replicate trays x 96 plants per treatment, experiment repeated 12 times, data of 3180 seedlings pooled; root/shoot length, root and shoot FRESH weight, leaf area, vigour index at 30 days after sowing; germination at 14 days. system: plastic humidity chambers, 30-day seedlings, leaf inoculation

system: plastic humidity chambers, 30-day seedlings, leaf inoculation

description: Greenhouse pot experiment, tomato cv. SC 2121 in perlite (3 seedlings/5 L pot), half-strength Hoagland NS. Control 0.05 mM B vs boron toxicity 2.0 mM B (H3BO3 in NS) during weeks 3-4 after germination; foliar GA3 100 mg L-1 and/or NaHS 0.2 mM once weekly x2; half of seedlings pre-soaked 12 h in 0.1 mM hypotaurine before treatments. Six plotted groups: C, BT, BT+GA, BT+GA+NaHS, BT+GA+HT, BT+GA+HT+NaHS. Each treatment 3 replications x 5 pots x 3 seedlings; one-way ANOVA, Duncan; Mean +/- S.E. Single destructive sampling 2 weeks after treatment start.
system: greenhouse pot, perlite, nutrient solution

description: Tomato cv. Zhongza9 seedlings, hydroponic (Hoagland, 20-L pots, 10 plants/pot) in plastic greenhouse, Baoding, Hebei (Mar-Jul 2019); 2x2: NaCl 0 vs 175 mmol/L x GABA 0 vs 5 mmol/L both added to nutrient solution from treatment onset (after 3 d pre-culture at four-true-leaf stage); fresh/dry weight sampled destructively at 2, 4, 6 d after treatment; Fig. 3 values mean +/- SD of three independent experiments.
